entries.questionEnglish: What are you doing next today?
entries.answer: 接下來我要去健身房。
entries.answerEnglish: Next I'm going to the gym.

entries.example: 你有注意到他剪頭髮了嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Did you notice he got a haircut?
entries.question: 來台灣後，你注意到什麼不一樣的地方？
entries.questionEnglish: Since coming to Taiwan, what differences have you noticed?
entries.answer: 我注意到這裡騎機車的人很多。
entries.answerEnglish: I've noticed that lots of people here ride scooters.

entries.example: 他在海邊撿了一顆石頭。
entries.exampleEnglish: He picked up a stone on the beach.
entries.question: 你旅行時會撿石頭當紀念嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pick up stones as souvenirs when you travel?
entries.answer: 會，我撿過花蓮海邊的石頭。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've picked up stones from the beach in Hualien.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ lǚ xíng shí huì jiǎn shí tou dàng jì niàn ma?

entries.example: 我的肩膀好痠。
entries.exampleEnglish: My shoulders are so stiff.
entries.question: 你工作久了，肩膀會痠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do your shoulders get stiff after working a long time?
entries.answer: 會，我的肩膀常常很痠。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my shoulders are often stiff.

entries.example: 日月潭的風景很美麗。
entries.exampleEnglish: The scenery at Sun Moon Lake is beautiful.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪裡的風景最美麗？
entries.questionEnglish: Where in Taiwan do you think has the most beautiful scenery?
entries.answer: 我覺得太魯閣的風景最美麗。
entries.answerEnglish: I think Taroko has the most beautiful scenery.

entries.example: 我立刻打電話給他。
entries.exampleEnglish: I called him right away.
entries.question: 你下班回家會立刻洗澡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you shower right away when you get home from work?
entries.answer: 會，我一回家就立刻洗澡。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I shower as soon as I get home.

entries.example: 我切菜的時候切到手指了。
entries.exampleEnglish: I cut my finger while chopping vegetables.
entries.question: 你玩手機玩太久，手指會痠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do your fingers get sore when you use your phone too long?
entries.answer: 會，我的手指有時候會痠。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my fingers get sore sometimes.

readings.examplePinyin: wǒ qiē cài de shí hòu qiē dào shǒu zhǐ le.

entries.example: 這隻狗的主人在哪裡？
entries.exampleEnglish: Where's this dog's owner?
entries.question: 你去朋友家，會帶禮物給主人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you visit a friend's home, do you bring the host a gift?
entries.answer: 會，我常帶水果給主人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often bring the host some fruit.

entries.example: 我哥哥是律師。
entries.exampleEnglish: My older brother is a lawyer.
entries.question: 你覺得當律師好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think being a lawyer is a good job?
entries.answer: 我覺得當律師很累，但是薪水高。
entries.answerEnglish: I think being a lawyer is tiring, but the pay is good.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de dāng lǜ shī hǎo ma?
readings.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de dāng lǜ shī hěn lèi, dàn shì xīn shuǐ gāo.

entries.example: 我對這件事有不同的看法。
entries.exampleEnglish: I see this differently.
entries.question: 你對台灣的交通有什麼看法？
entries.questionEnglish: What's your view of the traffic in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我的看法是機車太多了。
entries.answerEnglish: My view is that there are too many scooters.

entries.example: 有困難就跟我說。
entries.exampleEnglish: If you run into any difficulty, just tell me.
entries.question: 你在台灣生活有什麼困難？
entries.questionEnglish: What difficulties do you have living in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 最大的困難是看不懂中文字。
entries.answerEnglish: The biggest difficulty is not being able to read Chinese.

entries.example: 轉角有一家便利商店。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a convenience store on the corner.
entries.question: 你家附近的轉角有什麼店？
entries.questionEnglish: What shop is on the corner near your home?
entries.answer: 我家轉角有一家早餐店。
entries.answerEnglish: There's a breakfast shop on the corner by my place.

entries.example: 台灣夏天太陽很大，皮膚容易曬黑。
entries.exampleEnglish: The summer sun in Taiwan is strong, so your skin tans easily.
entries.question: 你的皮膚怕曬太陽嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your skin sensitive to the sun?
entries.answer: 很怕，我的皮膚很容易曬傷。
entries.answerEnglish: Very. My skin burns easily.

entries.example: 奶奶在院子裡種菜。
entries.exampleEnglish: Grandma grows vegetables in the yard.
entries.question: 你小時候家裡有院子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did your home have a yard when you were a kid?
entries.answer: 有，我家的院子很大。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our yard was very big.

entries.example: 我在便利商店買了一本雜誌。
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a magazine at the convenience store.
entries.question: 你還會買雜誌嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you still buy magazines?
entries.answer: 很少，我現在都看電子雜誌。
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. These days I read digital magazines.

entries.english: be responsible for; in charge of
entries.example: 我負責公司的網站。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm in charge of the company website.
entries.question: 你在公司負責什麼工作？
entries.questionEnglish: What are you responsible for at your company?
entries.answer: 我負責行銷的工作。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm responsible for marketing.

entries.example: 台灣是一座島。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan is an island.
entries.question: 你去過台灣附近的哪些島？
entries.questionEnglish: Which islands around Taiwan have you been to?
entries.answer: 我去過綠島和蘭嶼。
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Green Island and Orchid Island.

entries.example: 請不要碰展覽的作品。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please don't touch the works on display.
entries.question: 你在路上碰過老朋友嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever run into an old friend on the street?
entries.answer: 碰過，我在捷運上碰到大學同學。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I ran into a university classmate on the MRT.

entries.example: 我的襪子破了一個洞。
entries.exampleEnglish: My sock has a hole in it.
entries.question: 你的衣服破洞了會怎麼辦？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when your clothes get a hole?
entries.answer: 衣服破洞我就買新的。
entries.answerEnglish: If my clothes get a hole, I just buy new ones.

entries.example: 我姊姊是一位科學家。
entries.exampleEnglish: My older sister is a scientist.
entries.question: 你小時候想當科學家嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you want to be a scientist when you were little?
entries.answer: 想啊，我小時候想當科學家。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I wanted to be a scientist as a kid.

readings.examplePinyin: wǒ jiě jie shì yí wèi kē xué jiā.

entries.example: 她買了一雙金色的鞋子。
entries.exampleEnglish: She bought a pair of gold shoes.
entries.question: 你喜歡金色的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like gold-colored things?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，金色太亮了。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Gold is too flashy.

readings.examplePinyin: tā mǎi le yì shuāng jīn sè de xié zi.

entries.example: 我喜歡自己住，比較自由。
entries.exampleEnglish: I like living alone; I have more freedom.
entries.question: 你覺得在台灣生活自由嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel free living in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 很自由，我想做什麼都可以。
entries.answerEnglish: Very free. I can do whatever I want.

entries.example: 我在收集便利商店的點數。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm collecting convenience store points.
entries.question: 你有收集什麼東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you collect anything?
entries.answer: 我喜歡收集明信片。
entries.answerEnglish: I like collecting postcards.

entries.example: 我的華語考試分數不錯。
entries.exampleEnglish: I got a pretty good score on my Chinese test.
entries.question: 你上次中文考試的分數怎麼樣？
entries.questionEnglish: How did you score on your last Chinese test?
entries.answer: 還不錯，分數比上次高。
entries.answerEnglish: Not bad. My score was higher than last time.

entries.example: 看到這張照片，我想起了媽媽。
entries.exampleEnglish: Seeing this photo, I thought of my mom.
entries.question: 什麼食物會讓你想起家鄉？
entries.questionEnglish: What food reminds you of home?
entries.answer: 吃起司會讓我想起家鄉。
entries.answerEnglish: Eating cheese reminds me of home.

entries.example: 我完全聽不懂台語。
entries.exampleEnglish: I can't understand Taiwanese at all.
entries.question: 你聽得懂台語嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you understand Taiwanese?
entries.answer: 完全聽不懂，太難了。
entries.answerEnglish: Not at all. It's too hard.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng de dǒng tái yǔ ma?

entries.example: 這樣分很公平。
entries.exampleEnglish: Splitting it this way is fair.
entries.question: 你覺得你的薪水公平嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your salary is fair?
entries.answer: 我覺得還算公平。
entries.answerEnglish: I think it's reasonably fair.

entries.example: 高鐵的速度很快。
entries.exampleEnglish: The high-speed rail is very fast.
entries.question: 你打中文字的速度快嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you fast at typing Chinese?
entries.answer: 不快，我打字的速度很慢。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I type slowly.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ dǎ zhōng wén zì de sù dù kuài ma?

entries.example: 這個假期我想去花蓮。
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to go to Hualien this holiday.
entries.question: 你下一個假期想去哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you want to go on your next holiday?
entries.answer: 我下一個假期想去日本。
entries.answerEnglish: On my next holiday I want to go to Japan.

entries.example: 到了台北再聯絡我。
entries.exampleEnglish: Get in touch when you get to Taipei.
entries.question: 你常跟家人聯絡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep in touch with your family often?
entries.answer: 常常，我每天都跟媽媽聯絡。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I talk to my mom every day.

entries.example: 巷子裡有一家小餐館。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a small restaurant in the alley.
entries.question: 你家附近有好吃的餐館嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any good restaurants near your home?
entries.answer: 有，有一家越南餐館很好吃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a really good Vietnamese restaurant.

entries.example: 我每天早上餵貓。
entries.exampleEnglish: I feed the cat every morning.
entries.question: 你家的寵物都是誰在餵？
entries.questionEnglish: Who feeds your pet?
entries.answer: 都是我在餵，一天餵兩次。
entries.answerEnglish: I do. I feed it twice a day.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de chǒng wù dōu shì shéi zài wèi?

entries.example: 你的中文進步很多！
entries.exampleEnglish: Your Chinese has improved a lot!
entries.question: 你覺得你的中文有進步嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your Chinese has improved?
entries.answer: 有，我的聽力進步了很多。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my listening has improved a lot.

entries.example: 夏天我整天開電風扇。
entries.exampleEnglish: In summer I keep the fan on all day.
entries.question: 你家用冷氣還是電風扇？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use air-conditioning or a fan at home?
entries.answer: 我比較常用電風扇，比較省錢。
entries.answerEnglish: I use the fan more; it saves money.

entries.example: 他的腳受了傷。
entries.exampleEnglish: He hurt his foot.
entries.question: 運動的時候，怎麼做才不會受傷？
entries.questionEnglish: How can you avoid getting hurt when you exercise?
entries.answer: 運動前先暖身，就比較不會受傷。
entries.answerEnglish: Warm up before you exercise and you're less likely to get hurt.

readings.questionPinyin: yùn dòng de shí hòu, zěn me zuò cái bú huì shòu shāng?
readings.answerPinyin: yùn dòng qián xiān nuǎn shēn, jiù bǐ jiào bú huì shòu shāng.

entries.example: 夜市很多攤位只收現金。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many night market stalls only take cash.
entries.question: 你身上常帶現金嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually carry cash?
entries.answer: 常帶，去夜市要用現金。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I need cash for the night market.

readings.examplePinyin: yè shì hěn duō tān wèi zhǐ shōu xiàn jīn.

entries.example: 週末我們去博物館看展覽。
entries.exampleEnglish: At the weekend we went to the museum to see an exhibition.
entries.question: 你喜歡去博物館嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like going to museums?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常去台北的博物館。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often go to museums in Taipei.

entries.example: 他這個月賺了很多錢。
entries.exampleEnglish: He made a lot of money this month.
entries.question: 你覺得在台灣容易賺錢嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think it's easy to make money in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 不太容易，賺錢很辛苦。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Earning money is hard work.

entries.example: 這個問題很複雜。
entries.exampleEnglish: This problem is complicated.
entries.question: 你覺得中文的語法複雜嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Chinese grammar is complicated?
entries.answer: 不太複雜，但是聲調很難。
entries.answerEnglish: Not very complicated, but the tones are hard.

entries.example: 一天學會中文是不可能的。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's impossible to learn Chinese in one day.
entries.question: 你覺得一年學好中文可能嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you can master Chinese in a year?
entries.answer: 不可能，至少要三年吧。
entries.answerEnglish: Impossible. It takes at least three years.

entries.example: 天氣越來越熱了。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's getting hotter and hotter.
entries.question: 你的中文越來越好了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your Chinese getting better and better?
entries.answer: 對，我的中文越來越好了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my Chinese is getting better and better.

entries.example: 她邀請我去她家吃飯。
entries.exampleEnglish: She invited me to dinner at her place.
entries.question: 你最近有邀請朋友來家裡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you invited friends over recently?
entries.answer: 有，上週我邀請同事來吃飯。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last week I invited coworkers over for dinner.

entries.example: 我們騎腳踏車過橋。
entries.exampleEnglish: We rode our bikes across the bridge.
entries.question: 你家附近有橋嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a bridge near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家旁邊有一座橋。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a bridge next to my home.

entries.example: 衣服還沒乾。
entries.exampleEnglish: The clothes aren't dry yet.
entries.question: 冬天你的皮膚會很乾嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your skin get dry in winter?
entries.answer: 會，冬天我的皮膚很乾。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my skin gets very dry in winter.

readings.questionPinyin: dōng tiān nǐ de pí fū huì hěn gān ma?

entries.example: 請提醒我明天帶雨傘。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please remind me to bring an umbrella tomorrow.
entries.question: 你都用什麼提醒自己做事？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you use to remind yourself of things?
entries.answer: 我都用手機提醒自己。
entries.answerEnglish: I use my phone to remind myself.

entries.example: 他今天穿西裝去面試。
entries.exampleEnglish: He wore a suit to his interview today.
entries.question: 你上班要穿西裝嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have to wear a suit to work?
entries.answer: 不用，我上班不穿西裝。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't wear a suit to work.

entries.example: 請把瓶子丟進回收桶。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please put the bottle in the recycling bin.
entries.question: 你喝完水會回收瓶子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you recycle bottles after you finish drinking?
entries.answer: 會，我都把瓶子拿去回收。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always recycle the bottles.

entries.example: 你的發音很正確。
entries.exampleEnglish: Your pronunciation is very accurate.
entries.question: 你覺得你的聲調正確嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your tones are correct?
entries.answer: 不太正確，我常說錯。
entries.answerEnglish: Not very. I often get them wrong.

entries.example: 我們的導遊很會說故事。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our tour guide is great at telling stories.
entries.question: 你想在台灣當導遊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a tour guide in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 想，我想當英文導遊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to be an English-speaking guide.

entries.example: 捷運站的入口在對面。
entries.exampleEnglish: The MRT station entrance is across the street.
entries.question: 你家大樓的入口在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where's the entrance to your building?
entries.answer: 入口在便利商店旁邊。
entries.answerEnglish: The entrance is next to the convenience store.

entries.example: 不要浪費食物。
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't waste food.
entries.question: 你覺得滑手機是浪費時間嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think scrolling on your phone is a waste of time?
entries.answer: 有時候是，我常浪費很多時間。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I often waste a lot of time.

entries.example: 我睡前喜歡看小說。
entries.exampleEnglish: I like reading novels before bed.
entries.question: 你最近在看什麼小說？
entries.questionEnglish: What novel are you reading lately?
entries.answer: 我在看一本推理小說。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm reading a mystery novel.

entries.example: 我平常七點起床。
entries.exampleEnglish: I usually get up at seven.
entries.question: 你平常週末做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you usually do at the weekend?
entries.answer: 我平常週末去爬山。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually go hiking at the weekend.

entries.example: 這瓶可樂沒氣了，不好喝。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bottle of cola has gone flat. It doesn't taste good.
entries.question: 你的腳踏車輪胎沒氣過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your bike ever had a flat tyre?
entries.answer: 有，上個星期我的輪胎沒氣了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my tyre went flat last week.

entries.english: a large stretch; a big patch; a vast expanse
entries.example: 山上有一大片茶園。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a large stretch of tea fields on the mountain.
entries.question: 你家附近有一大片草地嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a big area of grass near your home?
entries.answer: 有，河邊有一大片草地。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a big stretch of grass by the river.

entries.example: 糟糕，我忘了帶鑰匙！
entries.exampleEnglish: Oh no, I forgot my keys!
entries.question: 你遇過最糟糕的天氣是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the worst weather you've ever had?
entries.answer: 最糟糕的是颱風天，又風又雨。
entries.answerEnglish: The worst was a typhoon day, with wind and rain.

entries.example: 老闆要求我們準時上班。
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss requires us to be on time for work.
entries.question: 你的老闆對你要求很高嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your boss expect a lot of you?
entries.answer: 還好，他對我的要求不高。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. He doesn't demand too much of me.

entries.example: 我每個星期都去踢足球。
entries.exampleEnglish: I go and play football every week.
entries.question: 你喜歡踢足球嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like playing football?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我週末常常去踢足球。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often play football on weekends.

entries.example: 這是我們兩個的秘密。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a secret between the two of us.
entries.question: 你會跟好朋友說秘密嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you tell secrets to your good friends?
entries.answer: 會，我什麼秘密都跟她說。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I tell her all my secrets.

entries.example: 台北下雪？不太可能。
entries.exampleEnglish: Snow in Taipei? Unlikely.
entries.question: 你今年會搬去別的城市嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Will you move to another city this year?
entries.answer: 不太可能，我很喜歡現在住的地方。
entries.answerEnglish: Unlikely. I really like where I live now.

entries.example: 他的感冒很嚴重。
entries.exampleEnglish: His cold is very bad.
entries.question: 你住的地方塞車嚴重嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is traffic bad where you live?
entries.answer: 很嚴重，上下班時間都塞車。
entries.answerEnglish: Very bad. There are traffic jams at rush hour.

entries.example: 很多阿姨晚上在廣場跳舞。
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of older ladies dance in the square in the evening.
entries.question: 你家附近有廣場嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a square near your home?
entries.answer: 有，捷運站前面有一個廣場。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a square in front of the MRT station.

entries.example: 她是電視台的記者。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a TV reporter.
entries.question: 你想當記者嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a journalist?
entries.answer: 不想，記者的工作太累了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, a journalist's job is too tiring.

entries.example: 我要去超商列印文件。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to the convenience store to print some documents.
entries.question: 你常在便利商店列印東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often print things at convenience stores?
entries.answer: 常常，我都去超商列印資料。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I always print documents at the convenience store.

entries.example: 吃不完可以打包嗎？

entries.answer: 我最常用的工具是手機。

entries.answer: 我會先上網查，再想辦法解決。

entries.exampleEnglish: It's so hot that I'm sweating a lot.
entries.question: 台灣的夏天你常流汗嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you sweat a lot in Taiwan's summer?
entries.answer: 常常，我走一下路就滿身大汗。
entries.answerEnglish: All the time. I'm drenched in sweat after a short walk.

entries.example: 吃飯前要用肥皂洗手。
entries.exampleEnglish: Wash your hands with soap before eating.
entries.question: 你喜歡用肥皂還是沐浴乳？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer bar soap or body wash?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡用肥皂。
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer bar soap.

entries.example: 地圖上的紅點就是我們這裡。
entries.exampleEnglish: The red dot on the map is where we are.
entries.question: 你喜歡有點點的衣服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like polka-dot clothes?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我有一件點點的洋裝。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a polka-dot dress.

entries.example: 這個廣告很好笑。
entries.exampleEnglish: This ad is really funny.
entries.question: 你看影片時會跳過廣告嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you skip ads when you watch videos?
entries.answer: 會，我都馬上跳過廣告。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always skip the ads right away.

entries.example: 可以給我一支叉子嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Could I have a fork, please?
entries.question: 你吃麵用筷子還是叉子？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you eat noodles with chopsticks or a fork?
entries.answer: 我吃義大利麵用叉子。
entries.answerEnglish: I use a fork for spaghetti.

entries.example: 冬天我都穿長褲。
entries.exampleEnglish: I always wear long pants in winter.
entries.question: 你上班要穿長褲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have to wear long pants to work?
entries.answer: 要，我上班都穿長褲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always wear long pants to work.

entries.example: 夜市人很多，要小心小偷。
entries.exampleEnglish: The night market is crowded, so watch out for thieves.
entries.question: 在哪裡要特別小心小偷？
entries.questionEnglish: Where should you be especially careful of thieves?
entries.answer: 在人很多的地方，像夜市和車站，要特別小心小偷。
entries.answerEnglish: In crowded places, like night markets and stations, you should be especially careful of thieves.

readings.questionPinyin: zài nǎ lǐ yào tè bié xiǎo xīn xiǎo tōu?
readings.answerPinyin: zài rén hěn duō de dì fāng, xiàng yè shì hé chē zhàn, yào tè bié xiǎo xīn xiǎo tōu.

entries.example: 小孩在公園吹泡泡。
entries.exampleEnglish: The kids are blowing bubbles in the park.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡吹泡泡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you like blowing bubbles as a child?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常常在公園吹泡泡。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often blew bubbles in the park.

entries.example: 中文的文法不太難。
entries.exampleEnglish: Chinese grammar isn't very hard.
entries.question: 你覺得中文的文法難嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Chinese grammar is hard?
entries.answer: 不難，中文的文法比英文簡單。
entries.answerEnglish: No, Chinese grammar is simpler than English grammar.

entries.example: 這間房子的缺點是太小。
entries.exampleEnglish: The drawback of this apartment is that it's too small.
entries.question: 你覺得自己有什麼缺點？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think your shortcomings are?
entries.answer: 我的缺點是常常遲到。
entries.answerEnglish: My weakness is that I'm often late.

entries.example: 她很害羞，不太說話。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very shy and doesn't talk much.
entries.question: 你說中文的時候會害羞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel shy when you speak Chinese?
entries.answer: 一開始會，現在比較不害羞了。
entries.answerEnglish: At first I did, but I'm less shy now.

entries.example: 台灣人對外國人很熱情。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwanese people are very warm toward foreigners.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人熱情嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people are warm?
entries.answer: 很熱情，常常有人主動幫我。
entries.answerEnglish: Very warm. People often offer to help me.

entries.example: 你應該跟他道歉。
entries.exampleEnglish: You should apologize to him.
entries.question: 你上次跟人道歉是什麼時候？
entries.questionEnglish: When did you last apologize to someone?
entries.answer: 昨天我遲到，跟朋友道歉了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yesterday. I was late and apologized to my friend.

entries.example: 這碗湯裡有紅蘿蔔和玉米。
entries.exampleEnglish: This soup has carrots and corn in it.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃紅蘿蔔嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like carrots?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我會把紅蘿蔔挑出來。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I pick the carrots out.

entries.example: 這把傘太小了，根本沒用。
entries.exampleEnglish: This umbrella is too small; it's useless.
entries.question: 你家有什麼沒用的東西？
entries.questionEnglish: What useless things do you have at home?
entries.answer: 我家有很多沒用的塑膠袋。
entries.answerEnglish: I have lots of useless plastic bags at home.

entries.example: 這個小孩很有禮貌。
entries.exampleEnglish: This child is very polite.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人有禮貌嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people are polite?
entries.answer: 我覺得台灣人很有禮貌。
entries.answerEnglish: I think Taiwanese people are very polite.

entries.example: 你突然出現，嚇到我了！
entries.exampleEnglish: You appeared out of nowhere and scared me!
entries.question: 什麼東西最容易嚇到你？
entries.questionEnglish: What scares you most easily?
entries.answer: 蟑螂最容易嚇到我。
entries.answerEnglish: Cockroaches scare me most easily.

readings.examplePinyin: nǐ tú rán chū xiàn, xià dào wǒ le!

entries.example: 這家餐廳的服務生很親切。
entries.exampleEnglish: The waiters at this restaurant are very friendly.
entries.question: 你當過服務生嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever worked as a waiter?
entries.answer: 當過，我大學時當過服務生。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was a waiter in college.

entries.example: 我的鑰匙掉在沙發底下。
entries.exampleEnglish: My keys fell under the sofa.
entries.question: 你的床底下放了什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you keep under your bed?
entries.answer: 我的床底下放了很多箱子。
entries.answerEnglish: I keep lots of boxes under my bed.

readings.answerPinyin: wǒ de chuáng dǐ xià fàng le hěn duō xiāng zi.

entries.example: 他不願意加班。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's unwilling to work overtime.
entries.question: 你願意週末加班嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you willing to work overtime on weekends?
entries.answer: 我不願意週末加班。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm not willing to work overtime on weekends.

entries.example: 我的行李箱太重了。
entries.exampleEnglish: My suitcase is too heavy.
entries.question: 你旅行時帶大的行李箱嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take a big suitcase when you travel?
entries.answer: 不，我只帶一個小行李箱。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I just take a small suitcase.

readings.answerPinyin: bù, wǒ zhǐ dài yí gè xiǎo xíng li xiāng.

entries.example: 我明天要去看牙醫。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to the dentist tomorrow.
entries.question: 你多久看一次牙醫？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you go to the dentist?
entries.answer: 我半年看一次牙醫。
entries.answerEnglish: I go to the dentist every six months.

entries.example: 在捷運上大聲講電話很沒禮貌。
entries.exampleEnglish: Talking loudly on the phone on the MRT is rude.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼行為很沒禮貌？
entries.questionEnglish: What behavior do you think is rude?
entries.answer: 我覺得插隊很沒禮貌。
entries.answerEnglish: I think cutting in line is rude.

entries.example: 今年很流行寬褲。
entries.exampleEnglish: Wide-leg pants are in style this year.
entries.question: 現在台灣流行什麼飲料？
entries.questionEnglish: What drinks are popular in Taiwan right now?
entries.answer: 現在很流行喝手搖飲。
entries.answerEnglish: Hand-shaken drinks are really popular now.

entries.example: 我每天早上都會刮鬍子。
entries.exampleEnglish: I shave every morning.
entries.question: 你每天都刮鬍子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you shave every day?
entries.answer: 對，我每天早上出門前都刮鬍子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I shave every morning before I go out.

entries.example: 爬完山，我的腳很痠痛。
entries.exampleEnglish: After climbing the mountain, my legs are really sore.
entries.question: 運動完你哪裡會痠痛？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you get sore after exercising?
entries.answer: 我的肩膀和腿都會痠痛。
entries.answerEnglish: My shoulders and legs get sore.

entries.example: 那個金髮的女生是我的同事。
entries.exampleEnglish: That blonde woman is my coworker.
entries.question: 你的家人有金髮嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does anyone in your family have blond hair?
entries.answer: 有，我妹妹是金髮。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my younger sister is blonde.

entries.example: 這家的炸雞皮很脆。
entries.exampleEnglish: The fried chicken skin here is really crispy.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃脆的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like eating crunchy things?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最愛吃脆的洋芋片。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love crunchy potato chips the most.

entries.example: 這盒餅乾的包裝很漂亮。
entries.exampleEnglish: The packaging on this box of cookies is really pretty.
entries.question: 你買東西會看包裝嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pay attention to packaging when you shop?
entries.answer: 會，包裝漂亮我就想買。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if the packaging is pretty, I want to buy it.

entries.example: 祝你週末愉快！
entries.exampleEnglish: Have a nice weekend!
entries.question: 你最近過得愉快嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been having a pleasant time lately?
entries.answer: 很愉快，我交了很多新朋友。
entries.answerEnglish: Very pleasant. I've made a lot of new friends.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn guò de yú kuài ma?

entries.example: 我用膠水把照片貼在卡片上。
entries.exampleEnglish: I glued the photo onto the card.
entries.question: 你上次用膠水做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What did you use glue for last time?
entries.answer: 我用膠水黏好了一雙鞋子。
entries.answerEnglish: I used glue to fix a pair of shoes.

readings.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng jiāo shuǐ nián hǎo le yì shuāng xié zi.

entries.example: 這種飲料沒有酒精。
entries.exampleEnglish: This drink has no alcohol.
entries.question: 你喝有酒精的飲料嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you drink alcoholic drinks?
entries.answer: 很少，我不太喝有酒精的飲料。
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. I don't drink much alcohol.

entries.example: 我昨天被蚊子叮了好多包。
entries.exampleEnglish: I got lots of mosquito bites yesterday.
entries.question: 你常被蚊子叮嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often get bitten by mosquitoes?
entries.answer: 常常，夏天我每天都被蚊子叮。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. In summer I get bitten by mosquitoes every day.

readings.examplePinyin: wǒ zuó tiān bèi wén zi dīng le hǎo duō bāo.
readings.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng bèi wén zi dīng ma?
readings.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, xià tiān wǒ měi tiān dōu bèi wén zi dīng.

entries.example: 這把刀很尖，要小心。
entries.exampleEnglish: This knife is very sharp at the tip; be careful.
entries.question: 你喜歡穿尖頭的鞋子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing pointy-toed shoes?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，尖頭的鞋子穿起來很痛。
entries.answerEnglish: No, pointy shoes hurt to wear.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chuān jiān tóu de xié zi ma?
readings.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, jiān tóu de xié zi chuān qǐ lái hěn tòng.

entries.english: get wrong; make a mistake; mix up
entries.example: 對不起，我搞錯時間了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Sorry, I got the time wrong.
entries.question: 你搞錯過捷運的方向嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever taken the MRT in the wrong direction?
entries.answer: 搞錯過，我坐到反方向了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once went the opposite way.

entries.example: 這根湯匙彎了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This spoon is bent.
entries.question: 你的雨傘被風吹彎過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your umbrella ever been bent by the wind?
entries.answer: 有，颱風天我的雨傘被吹彎了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my umbrella got bent on a typhoon day.

entries.example: 我每天喝兩公升的水。
entries.exampleEnglish: I drink two liters of water every day.
entries.question: 你一天喝幾公升的水？
entries.questionEnglish: How many liters of water do you drink a day?
entries.answer: 我一天大概喝一公升的水。
entries.answerEnglish: I drink about one liter of water a day.

entries.example: 這包咖啡豆有兩百公克。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bag of coffee beans is 200 grams.
entries.question: 你一次可以吃幾公克的牛排？
entries.questionEnglish: How many grams of steak can you eat at once?
entries.answer: 我可以吃三百公克的牛排。
entries.answerEnglish: I can eat a 300-gram steak.

entries.example: 我爸爸去年退休了。
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad retired last year.
entries.question: 你想幾歲退休？
entries.questionEnglish: At what age do you want to retire?
entries.answer: 我想五十五歲就退休。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to retire at fifty-five.

entries.example: 超商有很多冷凍食品。
entries.exampleEnglish: Convenience stores have lots of frozen food.
entries.question: 你常吃冷凍水餃嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often eat frozen dumplings?
entries.answer: 常吃，我冰箱裡都有冷凍水餃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always have frozen dumplings in my freezer.

entries.example: 我每天上班都會路過這家店。
entries.exampleEnglish: I pass this shop every day on my way to work.
entries.question: 你上班會路過什麼地方？
entries.questionEnglish: What places do you pass on your way to work?
entries.answer: 我上班會路過一個公園。
entries.answerEnglish: I pass a park on my way to work.

entries.example: 我忘了他的名字，好尷尬。
entries.exampleEnglish: I forgot his name. So embarrassing.
entries.question: 你遇過什麼尷尬的事？
entries.questionEnglish: What embarrassing things have happened to you?
entries.answer: 我曾經叫錯老闆的名字，很尷尬。
entries.answerEnglish: I once called my boss by the wrong name. It was awkward.

entries.example: 她的歌聲很好聽。
entries.exampleEnglish: She has a lovely singing voice.
entries.question: 你喜歡哪個歌手的歌聲？
entries.questionEnglish: Which singer's voice do you like?
entries.answer: 我很喜歡周杰倫的歌聲。
entries.answerEnglish: I really like Jay Chou's singing.

entries.example: 那家早餐店的老闆很親切。
entries.exampleEnglish: The owner of that breakfast shop is very friendly.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人親切嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people are friendly?
entries.answer: 很親切，大家都很願意幫忙。
entries.answerEnglish: Very friendly. Everyone is willing to help.

entries.example: 你說的話很有道理。
entries.exampleEnglish: What you said makes a lot of sense.
entries.question: 你覺得誰的建議最有道理？
entries.questionEnglish: Whose advice do you think makes the most sense?
entries.answer: 我覺得我爸爸的建議最有道理。
entries.answerEnglish: I think my dad's advice makes the most sense.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shéi de jiàn yì zuì yǒu dào lǐ?

entries.example: 這家語言中心的課程很多。
entries.exampleEnglish: This language center offers a lot of courses.
entries.question: 你現在上什麼中文課程？
entries.questionEnglish: What Chinese course are you taking now?
entries.answer: 我在上一個晚上的中文課程。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm taking an evening Chinese course.

entries.example: 請按照順序排隊。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please line up in order.
entries.question: 你早上出門前做事的順序是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: In what order do you do things before leaving in the morning?
entries.answer: 我的順序是洗澡、吃早餐、換衣服。
entries.answerEnglish: My order is shower, breakfast, then get dressed.

entries.example: 這位醫師很有經驗。
entries.exampleEnglish: This doctor is very experienced.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過醫師嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a doctor in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，那位醫師很親切。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, that doctor was very kind.

entries.example: 這件衣服超過一千塊了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This piece of clothing costs over a thousand dollars.
entries.question: 你一天工作超過八小時嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you work more than eight hours a day?
entries.answer: 常常超過，我很少準時下班。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I rarely leave work on time.

entries.example: 這部劇我昨天看了五集。
entries.exampleEnglish: I watched five episodes of this show yesterday.
entries.question: 你一天最多看幾集電視劇？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the most episodes of a TV series you watch in a day?
entries.answer: 我一天最多看三集。
entries.answerEnglish: I watch three episodes a day at most.

entries.example: 夜市的烤玉米很好吃。
entries.exampleEnglish: The grilled corn at the night market is delicious.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃玉米嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like eating corn?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最愛吃烤玉米。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love grilled corn the most.

entries.example: 洗手間在走廊的盡頭。
entries.exampleEnglish: The restroom is at the end of the hallway.
entries.question: 你的辦公室走廊上有什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's in the hallway of your office?
entries.answer: 走廊上有一台飲水機。
entries.answerEnglish: There's a water dispenser in the hallway.

entries.example: 不管下不下雨，我都要去。
entries.exampleEnglish: Whether it rains or not, I'm going.
entries.question: 不管多忙，你每天都會做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: No matter how busy you are, what do you do every day?
entries.answer: 不管多忙，我每天都會運動。
entries.answerEnglish: No matter how busy I am, I exercise every day.

entries.example: 我朋友說這間房子有鬼。
entries.exampleEnglish: My friend says this house is haunted.
entries.question: 你相信有鬼嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe in ghosts?
entries.answer: 不太相信，但我還是怕鬼。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really, but I'm still scared of ghosts.

entries.example: 捷運是我最常用的交通工具。
entries.exampleEnglish: The MRT is the transportation I use most.
entries.question: 你上班坐什麼交通工具？
entries.questionEnglish: What transportation do you take to work?
entries.answer: 我上班的交通工具是公車。
entries.answerEnglish: I take the bus to work.

entries.example: 夜市有各種小吃。
entries.exampleEnglish: The night market has all kinds of snacks.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃各國的菜嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like food from different countries?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡吃各種不同的菜。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like eating all kinds of different food.

entries.example: 我把水果放在籃子裡。
entries.exampleEnglish: I put the fruit in the basket.
entries.question: 你去市場會帶籃子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you bring a basket to the market?
entries.answer: 會，我都帶一個籃子去市場。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always take a basket to the market.

entries.example: 我喜歡在茶裡加蜂蜜。
entries.exampleEnglish: I like adding honey to my tea.
entries.question: 你喝茶會加蜂蜜嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you put honey in your tea?
entries.answer: 會，我喝紅茶會加一點蜂蜜。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I add a little honey to black tea.

entries.example: 我的房東人很好，常送我水果。
entries.exampleEnglish: My landlord is very nice and often gives me fruit.
entries.question: 你的房東是怎麼樣的人？
entries.questionEnglish: What is your landlord like?
entries.answer: 我的房東是一位很親切的阿姨。
entries.answerEnglish: My landlord is a very friendly middle-aged lady.

entries.example: 捷運站貼了很多電影海報。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of movie posters up in the MRT station.
entries.question: 你房間裡有貼海報嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have posters up in your room?
entries.answer: 有，我貼了一張樂團的海報。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I put up a poster of a band.

entries.example: 我中午吃了鮭魚便當。
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a salmon bento for lunch.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃鮭魚嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like salmon?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最喜歡吃鮭魚壽司。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, salmon sushi is my favorite.

entries.example: 這道菜放了很多大蒜。
entries.exampleEnglish: This dish has a lot of garlic in it.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃大蒜嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like garlic?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我吃香腸一定要配大蒜。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always eat Taiwanese sausage with garlic.

entries.example: 很多名人都來過這家餐廳。
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of celebrities have eaten at this restaurant.
entries.question: 你在台灣遇過名人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever run into a celebrity in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 遇過，我在機場看過一個名人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw a celebrity at the airport.

entries.example: 爸媽每個月給弟弟零用錢。
entries.exampleEnglish: My parents give my younger brother pocket money every month.
entries.question: 你小時候有零用錢嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you get pocket money as a child?
entries.answer: 有，我每個禮拜有五十塊零用錢。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I got fifty dollars of pocket money a week.

entries.example: 他最大的優點是很有耐心。
entries.exampleEnglish: His greatest strength is his patience.
entries.question: 你最大的優點是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's your greatest strength?
entries.answer: 我最大的優點是很樂觀。
entries.answerEnglish: My greatest strength is that I'm optimistic.

entries.example: 搭捷運要抓住拉環。
entries.exampleEnglish: Hold on to the hand strap when you ride the MRT.
entries.question: 你會抓住每個說中文的機會嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you seize every chance to speak Chinese?
entries.answer: 會，我會抓住每個說中文的機會。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I seize every chance to speak Chinese.

entries.example: 我報名了下個月的馬拉松。
entries.exampleEnglish: I signed up for next month's marathon.
entries.question: 你最近報名了什麼課？
entries.questionEnglish: What classes have you signed up for recently?
entries.answer: 我報名了週末的烹飪課。
entries.answerEnglish: I signed up for a weekend cooking class.

entries.example: 霧太大了，什麼都看不見。
entries.exampleEnglish: The fog is so thick that you can't see anything.
entries.question: 你不戴眼鏡看得見嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you see without your glasses?
entries.answer: 看不見，我近視很深。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm very nearsighted.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ bú dài yǎn jìng kàn de jiàn ma?

entries.example: 今天陽光很好，我們去散步吧！
entries.exampleEnglish: It's sunny today. Let's go for a walk!
entries.question: 你喜歡有陽光的房間嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like rooms that get sunlight?
entries.answer: 喜歡，有陽光的房間比較舒服。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, sunny rooms are more comfortable.

entries.example: 歡迎給我們一些意見。
entries.exampleEnglish: We welcome your feedback.
entries.question: 你買東西前會問朋友的意見嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you ask friends for their opinion before you buy things?
entries.answer: 會，我買衣服前會問朋友的意見。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I ask my friends' opinion before buying clothes.

entries.example: 週末我有一個朋友的聚會。
entries.exampleEnglish: I have a get-together with friends this weekend.
entries.question: 你常參加聚會嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often go to gatherings?
entries.answer: 常常，我每個月有兩、三個聚會。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have two or three get-togethers a month.

entries.example: 我認為這個方法比較好。
entries.exampleEnglish: I think this method is better.
entries.question: 你認為台北最好玩的地方是哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think is the most fun place in Taipei?
entries.answer: 我認為士林夜市最好玩。
entries.answerEnglish: I think Shilin Night Market is the most fun.

entries.example: 我每天在公園跑三圈。
entries.exampleEnglish: I run three laps around the park every day.
entries.question: 你跑步的時候通常跑幾圈？
entries.questionEnglish: How many laps do you usually run?
entries.answer: 我通常在操場跑五圈。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually run five laps around the track.

entries.example: 這家店的商品都很便宜。
entries.exampleEnglish: Everything in this shop is cheap.
entries.question: 你常在網路上買什麼商品？
entries.questionEnglish: What kinds of products do you often buy online?
entries.answer: 我常在網路上買3C商品。
entries.answerEnglish: I often buy electronics online.

entries.example: 寶貝，晚餐好了！
entries.exampleEnglish: Sweetheart, dinner's ready!
entries.question: 你家裡誰是大家的寶貝？
entries.questionEnglish: Who is everyone's darling in your family?
entries.answer: 我家的狗是大家的寶貝。
entries.answerEnglish: Our dog is everyone's darling.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lǐ shéi shì dà jiā de bǎo bèi?

entries.example: 我在台北租了一間套房。
entries.exampleEnglish: I rent a studio in Taipei.
entries.question: 你現在住套房還是公寓？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you live in a studio or an apartment now?
entries.answer: 我住套房，一個人住剛好。
entries.answerEnglish: I live in a studio; it's just right for one person.

entries.example: 她的眉毛很濃。
entries.exampleEnglish: Her eyebrows are thick.
entries.question: 你會自己修眉毛嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you trim your own eyebrows?
entries.answer: 會，我每個星期修一次眉毛。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I trim my eyebrows once a week.

entries.example: 這個枕頭太高了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This pillow is too high.
entries.question: 你喜歡軟的還是硬的枕頭？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer soft or firm pillows?
entries.answer: 我喜歡軟一點的枕頭。
entries.answerEnglish: I like a softer pillow.

entries.example: 雲遮住了月亮。
entries.exampleEnglish: The clouds hid the moon.
entries.question: 拍照時，你會遮住臉嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cover your face when someone takes a photo?
entries.answer: 有時候會，我會用手遮住臉。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes; I cover my face with my hand.

entries.example: 祝福你們新婚快樂！
entries.exampleEnglish: Wishing you a happy marriage!
entries.question: 朋友結婚時，你會說什麼祝福的話？
entries.questionEnglish: What good wishes do you say when a friend gets married?
entries.answer: 我會祝福他們永遠幸福。
entries.answerEnglish: I wish them happiness forever.

entries.example: 他把行李拖上樓。
entries.exampleEnglish: He dragged the luggage upstairs.
entries.question: 搬家時，你會自己拖重的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you move house, do you haul heavy things yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我會自己把箱子拖過去。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I drag the boxes over myself.

readings.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì zì jǐ bǎ xiāng zi tuō guò qù.

entries.example: 他比以前成熟多了。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's much more mature than before.
entries.question: 你覺得自己成熟嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're mature?
entries.answer: 我覺得我比以前成熟多了。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm much more mature than I used to be.

entries.example: 我把約會寫在日曆上。
entries.exampleEnglish: I wrote the appointment on the calendar.
entries.question: 你用手機日曆還是紙的日曆？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a phone calendar or a paper one?
entries.answer: 我都用手機的日曆。
entries.answerEnglish: I always use the calendar on my phone.

entries.example: 水餃要沾醬油才好吃。
entries.exampleEnglish: Dumplings taste better dipped in soy sauce.
entries.question: 你吃水餃喜歡沾什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you like to dip your dumplings in?
entries.answer: 我喜歡沾醬油和辣椒。
entries.answerEnglish: I like dipping them in soy sauce and chili.

entries.example: 她是一個很善良的人。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a very kind person.
entries.question: 你身邊誰最善良？
entries.questionEnglish: Who's the kindest person around you?
entries.answer: 我媽媽最善良，常常幫助別人。
entries.answerEnglish: My mom is the kindest; she often helps others.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn biān shéi zuì shàn liáng?

entries.example: 這個罐子打不開。
entries.exampleEnglish: This jar won't open.
entries.question: 你家用罐子裝什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you keep in jars at home?
entries.answer: 我用罐子裝餅乾和糖。
entries.answerEnglish: I keep cookies and sugar in jars.

readings.examplePinyin: zhè ge guàn zi dǎ bù kāi.
readings.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yòng guàn zi zhuāng shén me?
readings.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng guàn zi zhuāng bǐng gān hé táng.

entries.example: 騎機車一定要戴安全帽。
entries.exampleEnglish: You must wear a helmet when riding a scooter.
entries.question: 你的安全帽是什麼顏色？
entries.questionEnglish: What color is your helmet?
entries.answer: 我的安全帽是黑色的。
entries.answerEnglish: My helmet is black.

entries.example: 我喜歡咖啡的香味。
entries.exampleEnglish: I love the smell of coffee.
entries.question: 你最喜歡什麼香味？
entries.questionEnglish: What scent do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡剛烤好的麵包香味。
entries.answerEnglish: I love the smell of freshly baked bread most.

entries.example: 農場裡有很多山羊。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of goats on the farm.
entries.question: 你喝過山羊奶嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had goat's milk?
entries.answer: 喝過，山羊奶的味道有點特別。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, goat's milk tastes a little unusual.

entries.example: 我很喜歡吃菇。
entries.exampleEnglish: I love eating mushrooms.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃什麼菇？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of mushrooms do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡吃杏鮑菇。
entries.answerEnglish: I like king oyster mushrooms.

entries.example: 這家餐廳值得排隊。
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant is worth lining up for.
entries.question: 你覺得來台灣值得嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think coming to Taiwan was worth it?
entries.answer: 很值得，我學到很多東西。
entries.answerEnglish: Totally worth it; I've learned a lot.

entries.example: 我住在市中心，交通很方便。
entries.exampleEnglish: I live downtown, so getting around is easy.
entries.question: 你住在市中心嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you live downtown?
entries.answer: 不是，我住在離市中心有點遠的地方。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I live a bit far from the city center.

entries.example: 今天的新娘好漂亮！
entries.exampleEnglish: The bride looks so beautiful today!
entries.question: 你參加過台灣的婚禮嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to a Taiwanese wedding?
entries.answer: 參加過，新娘換了三套禮服。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the bride changed into three different gowns.

entries.example: 我是屬龍的。
entries.exampleEnglish: I was born in the Year of the Dragon.
entries.question: 你看過划龍舟比賽嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever watched a dragon boat race?
entries.answer: 看過，去年端午節我去看划龍舟。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I went to watch the dragon boat races last Dragon Boat Festival.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò huá lóng zhōu bǐ sài ma?
readings.answerPinyin: kàn guò, qù nián duān wǔ jié wǒ qù kàn huá lóng zhōu.

entries.example: 花園裡有很多蝴蝶。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of butterflies in the garden.
entries.question: 你在哪裡看過很多蝴蝶？
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen lots of butterflies?
entries.answer: 我在陽明山看過很多蝴蝶。
entries.answerEnglish: I saw lots of butterflies on Yangmingshan.

entries.example: 小孩手上拿著一顆氣球。
entries.exampleEnglish: The child is holding a balloon.
entries.question: 你看過台東的熱氣球嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen the hot-air balloons in Taitung?
entries.answer: 看過，熱氣球飛在天上很漂亮。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the hot-air balloons look beautiful in the sky.

readings.examplePinyin: xiǎo hái shǒu shàng ná zhe yì kē qì qiú.

entries.example: 台灣常常有地震。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan often has earthquakes.
entries.question: 你在台灣遇過地震嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been through an earthquake in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 遇過，第一次遇到地震很害怕。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the first time I was really scared.

entries.example: 不要在路上吐口香糖。
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't spit gum on the street.
entries.question: 吃魚的時候，你怎麼處理魚刺？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do with the bones when you eat fish?
entries.answer: 我會把魚刺吐出來。
entries.answerEnglish: I spit the bones out.

entries.example: 我的看法跟他相反。
entries.exampleEnglish: My view is the opposite of his.
entries.question: 你跟你的家人個性一樣還是相反？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your personality like your family's or the opposite?
entries.answer: 我跟我姐姐的個性完全相反。
entries.answerEnglish: My sister and I have completely opposite personalities.

entries.example: 我家的吸塵器壞了，要買新的。
entries.exampleEnglish: My vacuum cleaner broke, so I need to buy a new one.
entries.question: 你多久用一次吸塵器？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you use a vacuum cleaner?
entries.answer: 我每個週末用一次吸塵器。
entries.answerEnglish: I vacuum once every weekend.

entries.example: 公司的休息室有咖啡機。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a coffee machine in the office break room.
entries.question: 你們公司有休息室嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company have a break room?
entries.answer: 有，我中午常在休息室吃飯。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often eat lunch in the break room.

entries.english: among; in the middle of; amid
entries.example: 我們三個人當中，他最高。
entries.exampleEnglish: Of the three of us, he's the tallest.
entries.question: 你的朋友當中，誰最會做菜？

entries.answer: 我的朋友當中，小林最會做菜。
entries.answerEnglish: Among my friends, Xiaolin is the best cook.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ de péng yǒu dāng zhōng, shéi zuì huì zuò cài?

entries.example: 外面又打雷又閃電，好可怕。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's thunder and lightning outside. It's so scary.
entries.question: 你怕打雷閃電嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you afraid of thunder and lightning?
entries.answer: 我不怕閃電，可是很怕打雷。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm not afraid of lightning, but I'm really scared of thunder.

entries.example: 浴室的燈泡壞了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The bathroom light bulb has burned out.
entries.question: 你會自己換燈泡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you change a light bulb yourself?
entries.answer: 會，換燈泡很簡單。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, changing a light bulb is easy.

entries.example: 我們週末常去體育館打球。
entries.exampleEnglish: We often go to the gym to play ball on weekends.
entries.question: 你家附近有體育館嗎？

entries.answer: 有，我常去那座體育館打羽毛球。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often play badminton at that gym.

entries.example: 這段廣告可以跳過。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can skip this ad.
entries.question: 看影片時，你會跳過廣告嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you watch videos, do you skip the ads?
entries.answer: 會，能跳過的廣告我一定跳過。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. If an ad can be skipped, I always skip it.

entries.example: 他切了一大塊蛋糕給我。
entries.exampleEnglish: He cut me a big piece of cake.
entries.question: 吃牛排時，你喜歡切大塊還是小塊？

entries.answer: 我喜歡切大塊，吃起來比較過癮。
entries.answerEnglish: I like big pieces. They're more satisfying.

readings.examplePinyin: tā qiē le yí dà kuài dàn gāo gěi wǒ.
readings.questionPinyin: chī niú pái shí, nǐ xǐ huan qiē dà kuài hái shì xiǎo kuài?
readings.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan qiē dà kuài, chī qǐ lái bǐ jiào guò yǐn.

entries.example: 台灣的地理位置很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan's geographical location is excellent.
entries.question: 你喜歡台灣的地理環境嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like Taiwan's geography?
entries.answer: 喜歡，台灣的地理環境有山也有海。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Taiwan's geography has both mountains and sea.

entries.example: 我們八點要上船去綠島。
entries.exampleEnglish: We're boarding the boat to Green Island at eight.
entries.question: 你上船前會吃暈船藥嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take seasickness pills before you get on a boat?
entries.answer: 會，我上船前一定會吃暈船藥。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I always take seasickness pills before I get on a boat.

entries.example: 我的包裹放在管理員那裡。
entries.exampleEnglish: My package is at the building manager's desk.
entries.question: 你住的大樓有管理員嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your building have a building manager?
entries.answer: 有，管理員會幫我們收包裹。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. The building manager takes in our packages for us.

entries.example: 我的牛排要五分熟。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like my steak medium.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃幾分熟的牛排？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you like your steak done?
entries.answer: 我喜歡七分熟的牛排。
entries.answerEnglish: I like my steak medium-well.

entries.example: 我週末常去書店看漫畫。
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends I often go to the bookstore to read comics.
entries.question: 你喜歡看哪一種漫畫？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of comics do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡看日本的運動漫畫。
entries.answerEnglish: I like Japanese sports manga.

entries.example: 我的老闆脾氣很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss is very good-tempered.
entries.question: 你覺得自己脾氣好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you have a good temper?
entries.answer: 還不錯，我很少發脾氣。
entries.answerEnglish: Not bad. I rarely lose my temper.

entries.example: 我週末常跟好友去爬山。
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends I often go hiking with my good friends.
entries.question: 你和好友常常一起做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you and your close friends often do together?
entries.answer: 我和好友常一起去夜市吃東西。
entries.answerEnglish: My friends and I often go eat at night markets together.

entries.example: 我在陽台曬衣服。
entries.exampleEnglish: I hang my laundry out on the balcony.
entries.question: 你家有陽台嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your home have a balcony?
entries.answer: 有，我在陽台種了一些花。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I've planted some flowers on the balcony.

readings.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zài yáng tái zhòng le yì xiē huā.

entries.example: 我想買一張圓形的桌子。
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to buy a round table.
entries.question: 你喜歡圓形的還是方形的桌子？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer round tables or square ones?
entries.answer: 我喜歡圓形的，吃飯比較熱鬧。
entries.answerEnglish: I like round ones. Meals feel livelier.

entries.example: 我晚上在當英文家教。
entries.exampleEnglish: I work as an English tutor in the evenings.
entries.question: 你當過家教嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever worked as a tutor?
entries.answer: 當過，我在台北當過英文家教。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was an English tutor in Taipei.

entries.example: 他一喝酒就臉紅。
entries.exampleEnglish: His face turns red as soon as he drinks.
entries.question: 你什麼時候會臉紅？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you blush?
entries.answer: 被別人稱讚的時候，我會臉紅。
entries.answerEnglish: I blush when people praise me.

entries.example: 吃完飯，我們點了甜點。
entries.exampleEnglish: After the meal, we ordered dessert.
entries.question: 你最喜歡的甜點是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's your favorite dessert?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的甜點是芒果冰。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite dessert is mango shaved ice.

entries.english: use; make use of; take advantage of
entries.example: 我利用午休時間去銀行。
entries.exampleEnglish: I use my lunch break to go to the bank.
entries.question: 你會利用週末學中文嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use your weekends to study Chinese?
entries.answer: 會，我利用週末上中文課。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I use my weekends to take Chinese classes.

entries.example: 我可以喝一小口嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Can I have a sip?
entries.question: 你會讓朋友喝一小口你的飲料嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you let a friend have a sip of your drink?
entries.answer: 會，我會讓好朋友喝一小口。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I'd let a good friend have a sip.

entries.example: 我在上中級中文課。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm taking an intermediate Chinese class.
entries.question: 你的中文是初級還是中級？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your Chinese beginner or intermediate?
entries.answer: 我的中文大概是中級。
entries.answerEnglish: My Chinese is about intermediate.

entries.example: 我每天用這個馬克杯喝咖啡。
entries.exampleEnglish: I drink coffee from this mug every day.
entries.question: 你有最喜歡的馬克杯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a favorite mug?
entries.answer: 有，我最喜歡朋友送我的馬克杯。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my favorite is a mug a friend gave me.

entries.example: 週末我們去河邊野餐吧！
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's go for a picnic by the river this weekend!
entries.question: 你喜歡去哪裡野餐？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you like to go for picnics?
entries.answer: 我喜歡去大安森林公園野餐。
entries.answerEnglish: I like having picnics in Daan Forest Park.

entries.example: 我姪子最喜歡恐龍。
entries.exampleEnglish: My nephew loves dinosaurs most of all.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡恐龍嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you like dinosaurs as a child?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我有很多恐龍玩具。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I had lots of dinosaur toys.

readings.examplePinyin: wǒ zhí zi zuì xǐ huan kǒng lóng.

entries.example: 我早餐常吃穀片加牛奶。
entries.exampleEnglish: I often have cereal with milk for breakfast.
entries.question: 你早餐會吃穀片嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you eat cereal for breakfast?
entries.answer: 有時候，我喜歡穀片加優格。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I like cereal with yogurt.

entries.example: 這兩家便利商店互相競爭。
entries.exampleEnglish: These two convenience stores compete with each other.
entries.question: 你的工作競爭激烈嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a lot of competition in your job?
entries.answer: 對，我們這一行競爭很激烈。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, competition in my line of work is fierce.

entries.example: 我們搭船去一座小島。
entries.exampleEnglish: We took a boat to a small island.
entries.question: 你去過台灣的哪些小島？
entries.questionEnglish: Which of Taiwan's small islands have you been to?
entries.answer: 我去過綠島，那是一座很美的小島。
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Green Island; it's a beautiful little island.

entries.example: 這盒櫻桃好貴！
entries.exampleEnglish: This box of cherries is so expensive!
entries.question: 你喜歡吃櫻桃嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like cherries?
entries.answer: 喜歡，可是台灣的櫻桃很貴。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but cherries are expensive in Taiwan.

entries.example: 我早餐吃火腿蛋餅。
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a ham egg crepe for breakfast.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃火腿嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like ham?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常吃火腿三明治。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often eat ham sandwiches.

entries.example: 我真是個笨蛋，又忘了帶鑰匙！
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm such an idiot, I forgot my keys again!
entries.question: 你什麼時候會覺得自己是笨蛋？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you feel like an idiot?
entries.answer: 我搭錯捷運的時候，會覺得自己是笨蛋。
entries.answerEnglish: When I take the wrong MRT line, I feel like an idiot.

entries.example: 加油站的服務員很親切。
entries.exampleEnglish: The gas station attendant is very friendly.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的服務員親切嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think service staff in Taiwan are friendly?
entries.answer: 很親切，餐廳的服務員都很有禮貌。
entries.answerEnglish: Very friendly. Restaurant staff are all very polite.

entries.example: 我早餐吃培根蛋餅。
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a bacon egg crepe for breakfast.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃培根嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like bacon?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最愛培根三明治。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love bacon sandwiches.

entries.example: 打雷的聲音讓我嚇一跳。
entries.exampleEnglish: The thunder startled me.
entries.question: 最近什麼事讓你嚇一跳？
entries.questionEnglish: What has startled you recently?
entries.answer: 電費帳單太貴，讓我嚇一跳。
entries.answerEnglish: The electricity bill was so high it gave me a fright.

entries.example: 寶特瓶要拿去回收。
entries.exampleEnglish: Plastic bottles should go to recycling.
entries.question: 你在家會做資源回收嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you recycle at home?
entries.answer: 會，我每天都會做資源回收。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I recycle every day.

entries.example: 便當可以用微波爐加熱。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can heat up a lunch box in the microwave.
entries.question: 你常用微波爐熱東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often heat food in the microwave?
entries.answer: 常用，我中午都用微波爐熱便當。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I heat my lunch box in the microwave every day.

entries.example: 我的簽證下個月到期。
entries.exampleEnglish: My visa expires next month.
entries.question: 你來台灣需要辦簽證嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you need a visa to come to Taiwan?
entries.answer: 需要，我來台灣前辦了簽證。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I got a visa before I came to Taiwan.

entries.example: 我在九份買了幾張明信片。
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a few postcards in Jiufen.
entries.question: 你旅行時會寄明信片嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you send postcards when you travel?
entries.answer: 會，我常常寄明信片給家人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often send postcards to my family.

entries.example: 吃餃子要加一點醋。
entries.exampleEnglish: Add a little vinegar when you eat dumplings.
entries.question: 你吃餃子喜歡加醋嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like vinegar with your dumplings?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我吃餃子一定加醋。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always add vinegar to dumplings.

readings.examplePinyin: chī jiǎo zi yào jiā yì diǎn cù.
readings.questionPinyin: nǐ chī jiǎo zi xǐ huan jiā cù ma?
readings.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ chī jiǎo zi yí dìng jiā cù.

entries.example: 每天塞車上班很痛苦。
entries.exampleEnglish: Sitting in traffic to work every day is agony.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你覺得很痛苦？
entries.questionEnglish: What feels like agony to you?
entries.answer: 早上很早起床讓我很痛苦。
entries.answerEnglish: Getting up really early is agony for me.

entries.example: 雨停了，天上有一道彩虹。
entries.exampleEnglish: The rain stopped, and there was a rainbow in the sky.
entries.question: 你最近看過彩虹嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a rainbow recently?
entries.answer: 看過，上週下完雨就有彩虹。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there was a rainbow after the rain last week.

entries.example: 我的衣櫥已經滿了。
entries.exampleEnglish: My wardrobe is already full.
entries.question: 你的衣櫥裡衣服多嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there a lot of clothes in your wardrobe?
entries.answer: 很多，我的衣櫥快放不下了。
entries.answerEnglish: Lots. My wardrobe can barely hold them.

entries.example: 這個便當很有營養。
entries.exampleEnglish: This lunch box is very nutritious.
entries.question: 你覺得你吃得有營養嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you eat nutritiously?
entries.answer: 還好，我會多吃青菜補充營養。
entries.answerEnglish: It's OK. I eat lots of vegetables for nutrition.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ chī de yǒu yíng yǎng ma?

entries.example: 請在表格上寫你的國籍。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please write your nationality on the form.
entries.question: 你有幾個國籍？
entries.questionEnglish: How many nationalities do you have?
entries.answer: 我只有一個國籍，是美國。
entries.answerEnglish: I only have one nationality: American.

entries.example: 在捷運上不能吃口香糖。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can't chew gum on the MRT.
entries.question: 你常常吃口香糖嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often chew gum?
entries.answer: 有時候，開會前我會吃口香糖。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I chew gum before meetings.

entries.example: 我女兒很想騎小馬。
entries.exampleEnglish: My daughter really wants to ride a pony.
entries.question: 你小時候騎過小馬嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you ride a pony when you were little?
entries.answer: 騎過，我在農場騎過小馬。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I rode a pony on a farm.

entries.example: 你去超商順便幫我買牛奶。
entries.exampleEnglish: Since you're going to the convenience store, get me some milk.
entries.question: 你下班回家會順便買晚餐嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pick up dinner on your way home from work?
entries.answer: 會，我常常順便買便當回家。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often pick up a boxed meal on the way home.

entries.example: 我買了一瓶香水送媽媽。
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a bottle of perfume for my mom.
entries.question: 你平常會噴香水嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually wear perfume?
entries.answer: 出門的時候我會噴一點香水。
entries.answerEnglish: I put on a little perfume when I go out.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ píng cháng huì pēn xiāng shuǐ ma?

entries.example: 昨天的地震把我嚇壞了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Yesterday's earthquake terrified me.
entries.question: 什麼東西會把你嚇壞？
entries.questionEnglish: What would scare you badly?
entries.answer: 會飛的蟑螂會把我嚇壞。
entries.answerEnglish: Flying cockroaches would terrify me.

entries.example: 對不起，我踩到你的腳了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Sorry, I stepped on your foot.
entries.question: 你在捷運上被人踩過腳嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has anyone ever stepped on your foot on the MRT?
entries.answer: 有，人多的時候常常被踩到。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it happens often when it's crowded.

entries.example: 我家後面有一片樹林。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a grove of trees behind my home.
entries.question: 你家附近有樹林嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any woods near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家附近有一片小樹林。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a small grove near my home.

entries.example: 我女兒在學小提琴。
entries.exampleEnglish: My daughter is learning the violin.
entries.question: 你會拉小提琴嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you play the violin?
entries.answer: 不會，但我很想學拉小提琴。
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I'd really like to learn the violin.

entries.example: 空服員送來了一杯熱茶。
entries.exampleEnglish: The flight attendant brought a cup of hot tea.
entries.question: 你想當空服員嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a flight attendant?
entries.answer: 不想，空服員的工作太累了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, a flight attendant's job is too tiring.

entries.example: 可以把字放大一點嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Could you make the text a bit bigger?
entries.question: 你看手機的時候會把字放大嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you enlarge the text when using your phone?
entries.answer: 會，我都把字放大來看。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always enlarge the text.

entries.example: 週末我常跟朋友下西洋棋。
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends I often play chess with friends.
entries.question: 你會下西洋棋嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you play chess?
entries.answer: 會，我小時候就學過西洋棋。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I learned chess as a child.

entries.example: 我們交換一下座位好嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Shall we swap seats?
entries.question: 你跟朋友交換過禮物嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever exchanged gifts with friends?
entries.answer: 有，聖誕節我們都會交換禮物。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we always exchange gifts at Christmas.

entries.example: 奶奶家養了三隻母雞。
entries.exampleEnglish: Grandma keeps three hens.
entries.question: 你小時候家裡有養母雞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did your family keep hens when you were young?
entries.answer: 有，我們家的母雞每天下蛋。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our hens laid eggs every day.

entries.example: 週末我們全家去郊遊。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our whole family went on an outing at the weekend.
entries.question: 你週末喜歡去哪裡郊遊？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you like to go for an outing on weekends?
entries.answer: 我喜歡去陽明山郊遊。
entries.answerEnglish: I like going on outings to Yangmingshan.

entries.example: 餅乾一拿起來就碎掉了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The cookie crumbled as soon as I picked it up.
entries.question: 你的手機螢幕碎掉過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your phone screen ever cracked?
entries.answer: 碎掉過，修理花了很多錢。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, and the repair cost a lot.

entries.example: 在台灣亂丟垃圾會被罰錢。
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taiwan you get fined for littering.
entries.question: 你看過有人亂丟垃圾嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen someone litter?
entries.answer: 看過，我覺得亂丟垃圾很沒禮貌。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think littering is very rude.

entries.example: 牛在草地上吃草。
entries.exampleEnglish: The cows are grazing in the field.
entries.question: 你看過羊吃草嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen sheep grazing?
entries.answer: 看過，我在清境農場看過羊吃草。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw sheep grazing at Cingjing Farm.

entries.example: 袋子裡的蛋糕被壓壞了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The cake in the bag got squashed.
entries.question: 你買的東西被壓壞過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has something you bought ever been crushed?
entries.answer: 有，網購的盒子被壓壞了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a box I ordered online got crushed.

readings.examplePinyin: dài zi lǐ de dàn gāo bèi yā huài le.

entries.example: 昨天晚上雷聲好大。
entries.exampleEnglish: The thunder was really loud last night.
entries.question: 你怕雷聲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you afraid of thunder?
entries.answer: 不怕，但雷聲太大會吵醒我。
entries.answerEnglish: No, but loud thunder wakes me up.

entries.example: 我是新手，請多指教。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm new at this, so please bear with me.
entries.question: 你做什麼事還是新手？
entries.questionEnglish: What are you still a beginner at?
entries.answer: 我做菜還是新手。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm still a beginner at cooking.

entries.example: 這隻小狗好可憐。
entries.exampleEnglish: This little dog is so pitiful.
entries.question: 你看到流浪狗會覺得可憐嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel sorry for stray dogs when you see them?
entries.answer: 會，我覺得牠們很可憐。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I feel they're very pitiful.

entries.example: 天氣冷，我多穿了一件背心。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's cold, so I put on an extra vest.
entries.question: 你夏天常穿背心嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often wear tank tops in summer?
entries.answer: 常穿，夏天穿背心很涼快。
entries.answerEnglish: Often; tank tops are cool in summer.

entries.example: 麵包放太久變硬了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The bread went hard after sitting too long.
entries.question: 你怎麼處理變硬的麵包？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do with bread that has gone hard?
entries.answer: 我把變硬的麵包烤一下再吃。
entries.answerEnglish: I toast hard bread before eating it.

entries.example: 母雞帶著小雞在散步。
entries.exampleEnglish: The hen is out walking with her chicks.
entries.question: 你小時候養過小雞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you ever raise chicks as a child?
entries.answer: 養過，我小時候養過一隻小雞。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I raised a chick when I was little.

readings.examplePinyin: mǔ jī dài zhe xiǎo jī zài sàn bù.

entries.example: 我種的植物終於開花了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The plant I grew has finally flowered.
entries.question: 你種的植物開花過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has any plant you've grown ever flowered?
entries.answer: 有，我種的蘭花開花了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my orchid has bloomed.

readings.examplePinyin: wǒ zhòng de zhí wù zhōng yú kāi huā le.
readings.questionPinyin: nǐ zhòng de zhí wù kāi huā guò ma?
readings.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zhòng de lán huā kāi huā le.

entries.example: 這裡的房租是我家鄉的三倍。
entries.exampleEnglish: Rent here is three times what it is in my hometown.
entries.question: 台北的房租比你家鄉貴幾倍？
entries.questionEnglish: How many times more expensive is rent in Taipei than in your hometown?
entries.answer: 台北的房租大概是我家鄉的三倍。
entries.answerEnglish: Rent in Taipei is about three times my hometown's.

entries.example: 她的女兒很活潑。
entries.exampleEnglish: Her daughter is very lively.
entries.question: 你小時候是活潑的孩子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Were you a lively child?
entries.answer: 是，我小時候很活潑。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was very lively as a child.

entries.example: 天上有一隻老鷹在飛。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's an eagle flying in the sky.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過老鷹嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen an eagle in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，我在山上看過老鷹。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw one in the mountains.

entries.example: 我的腰有點疼。
entries.exampleEnglish: My lower back aches a bit.
entries.question: 你工作久了哪裡會疼？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you ache after working a long time?
entries.answer: 坐太久我的背會疼。
entries.answerEnglish: My back aches if I sit too long.

entries.example: 我們輪流開車去花蓮。
entries.exampleEnglish: We took turns driving to Hualien.
entries.question: 你家的家事是大家輪流做嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do people at home take turns doing chores?
entries.answer: 是，我們輪流洗碗。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we take turns washing the dishes.

entries.example: 鄉下的公雞早上五點就叫了。
entries.exampleEnglish: In the countryside the roosters crow at five in the morning.
entries.question: 你聽過公雞叫嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever heard a rooster crow?
entries.answer: 聽過，我住鄉下時每天聽公雞叫。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I heard roosters every day when I lived in the countryside.

entries.english: at the same time; meanwhile; simultaneous
entries.example: 我們兩個同時到了餐廳。
entries.exampleEnglish: The two of us got to the restaurant at the same time.
entries.question: 你可以同時做兩件事嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you do two things at the same time?
entries.answer: 可以，我常常同時聽音樂跟工作。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often listen to music and work at the same time.

entries.example: 我好羨慕你可以去日本玩！
entries.exampleEnglish: I really envy you getting to go to Japan!
entries.question: 你最羨慕誰？
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you envy most?
entries.answer: 我最羨慕我哥哥，他每年都出國玩。
entries.answerEnglish: I envy my older brother most; he travels abroad every year.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xiàn mù shéi?

entries.example: 她今天擦了紅色的口紅。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's wearing red lipstick today.
entries.question: 你常擦口紅嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often wear lipstick?
entries.answer: 上班的時候我會擦口紅。
entries.answerEnglish: I wear lipstick when I go to work.

entries.example: 週末的高速公路很塞。
entries.exampleEnglish: The freeway is jammed on weekends.
entries.question: 你常開高速公路嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often drive on the freeway?
entries.answer: 我回南部的時候會開高速公路。
entries.answerEnglish: I take the freeway when I go back down south.

entries.example: 他很喜歡看體育新聞。
entries.exampleEnglish: He loves watching sports news.
entries.question: 你喜歡看哪種體育節目？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of sports programs do you like to watch?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡看體育台的棒球比賽。
entries.answerEnglish: I like watching baseball games on the sports channel most.

entries.example: 我坐太久，站起來有點頭暈。
entries.exampleEnglish: I sat too long and felt a bit dizzy when I stood up.
entries.question: 你坐船會頭暈嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get dizzy on boats?
entries.answer: 會，我坐船一定會頭暈。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always get dizzy on boats.

entries.example: 他們昨天又吵架了。
entries.exampleEnglish: They had another argument yesterday.
entries.question: 你常跟家人吵架嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often argue with your family?
entries.answer: 不常，我們很少吵架。
entries.answerEnglish: Not often; we rarely argue.

entries.example: 下雨天地很滑，小心！
entries.exampleEnglish: The floor is slippery on rainy days. Be careful!
entries.question: 下雨天你騎車會怕路滑嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When it rains, are you afraid of slippery roads when you ride?
entries.answer: 會，路很滑的時候我會騎很慢。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I ride very slowly when the road is slippery.

entries.example: 這道菜放了很多辣椒。
entries.exampleEnglish: This dish has a lot of chili in it.
entries.question: 你吃得了辣椒嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you handle chili?
entries.answer: 吃得了，我很喜歡吃辣椒。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love eating chili.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ chī de liǎo là jiāo ma?
readings.answerPinyin: chī de liǎo, wǒ hěn xǐ huan chī là jiāo.

entries.example: 我的中文老師常常鼓勵我多開口。
entries.exampleEnglish: My Chinese teacher often encourages me to speak up more.
entries.question: 學中文時，誰最常鼓勵你？
entries.questionEnglish: Who encourages you the most when you're learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我的台灣朋友最常鼓勵我。
entries.answerEnglish: My Taiwanese friends encourage me the most.

readings.questionPinyin: xué zhōng wén shí, shéi zuì cháng gǔ lì nǐ?

entries.example: 我十幾歲的時候住在倫敦。
entries.exampleEnglish: I lived in London when I was a teenager.
entries.question: 你十幾歲的時候喜歡做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What did you like to do when you were a teenager?
entries.answer: 我十幾歲的時候很喜歡打電動。
entries.answerEnglish: When I was a teenager, I loved playing video games.

entries.example: 電影看到一半，我就睡著了。
entries.exampleEnglish: I fell asleep halfway through the movie.
entries.question: 你常常看電影看到一半就睡著嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often fall asleep halfway through a movie?
entries.answer: 常常，我在家看電影常看到一半就睡著。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. When I watch movies at home, I often fall asleep halfway.
