entries.question: 來台灣後，你的生活有巨大的改變嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your life changed hugely since you came to Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有，我的生活有了巨大的改變。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my life has changed enormously.

entries.example: 這片森林還保持原始的樣子。
entries.exampleEnglish: This forest is still in its original, untouched state.
entries.question: 你喜歡去原始的自然環境旅行嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like traveling to unspoiled natural places?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡去原始的山林走走。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like walking in untouched mountain forests.

entries.example: 吃了藥以後，疼痛好多了。
entries.exampleEnglish: After taking the medicine, the pain is much better.
entries.question: 長時間用電腦，哪裡容易疼痛？
entries.questionEnglish: After using a computer for a long time, where do people tend to ache?
entries.answer: 長時間用電腦，肩膀和脖子容易疼痛。
entries.answerEnglish: Using a computer for a long time tends to make your shoulders and neck ache.

readings.questionPinyin: cháng shí jiān yòng diàn nǎo, nǎ lǐ róng yì téng tòng?
readings.answerPinyin: cháng shí jiān yòng diàn nǎo, jiān bǎng hé bó zi róng yì téng tòng.

entries.example: 這支手機的電池需要更換了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This phone's battery needs replacing.
entries.question: 你多久更換一次手機？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you replace your phone?
entries.answer: 我大概三年更換一次手機。
entries.answerEnglish: I replace my phone about every three years.

entries.example: 多數人週末都會出去玩。
entries.exampleEnglish: Most people go out at the weekend.
entries.question: 在你的公司，多數同事是哪裡人？
entries.questionEnglish: At your company, where are most of your coworkers from?
entries.answer: 多數同事是台灣人。
entries.answerEnglish: Most of my coworkers are Taiwanese.

entries.example: 我爸爸喜歡收藏老唱片。
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad likes collecting old records.
entries.question: 你有收藏什麼東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you collect anything?
entries.answer: 我收藏了很多國家的硬幣。
entries.answerEnglish: I've collected coins from lots of countries.

entries.example: 這次選舉有三位候選人。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are three candidates in this election.
entries.question: 選舉的時候，你怎麼選候選人？
entries.questionEnglish: At election time, how do you choose a candidate?
entries.answer: 我會先看候選人說要做什麼。
entries.answerEnglish: First I look at what the candidates say they'll do.

entries.example: 名片上要寫你的職稱。
entries.exampleEnglish: Your business card should show your job title.
entries.question: 你在公司的職稱是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's your job title at your company?
entries.answer: 我的職稱是專案經理。
entries.answerEnglish: My title is project manager.

entries.example: 他們的婚姻很幸福。
entries.exampleEnglish: They have a very happy marriage.
entries.question: 你覺得幸福的婚姻需要什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think a happy marriage needs?
entries.answer: 我覺得幸福的婚姻需要互相尊重。
entries.answerEnglish: I think a happy marriage needs mutual respect.

entries.example: 出門前請確保門有鎖好。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please make sure the door is locked before you go out.
entries.question: 出國前，你怎麼確保東西都帶了？
entries.questionEnglish: Before going abroad, how do you make sure you've packed everything?
entries.answer: 我會寫清單，確保東西都帶了。
entries.answerEnglish: I write a checklist to make sure I've got everything.

entries.example: 我換了一個比較便宜的手機方案。
entries.exampleEnglish: I switched to a cheaper phone plan.
entries.question: 你的手機方案每個月多少錢？
entries.questionEnglish: How much is your phone plan each month?
entries.answer: 我的方案每個月四百九十九塊。
entries.answerEnglish: My plan is 499 dollars a month.

entries.example: 他顯然不想去。
entries.exampleEnglish: He obviously doesn't want to go.
entries.question: 你覺得你的同事今天心情好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your coworker is in a good mood today?
entries.answer: 顯然不好，他一句話都沒說。
entries.answerEnglish: Obviously not. He hasn't said a word.

entries.example: 他是這個協會的主席。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's the chairman of this association.
entries.question: 你們公司開會時，誰當主席？
entries.questionEnglish: Who chairs the meetings at your company?
entries.answer: 通常是我們經理當主席。
entries.answerEnglish: Usually our manager chairs them.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī kāi huì shí, shéi dāng zhǔ xí?

entries.example: 每個公民都有投票的權利。
entries.exampleEnglish: Every citizen has the right to vote.
entries.question: 你是哪個國家的公民？
entries.questionEnglish: Which country are you a citizen of?
entries.answer: 我是加拿大公民。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm a Canadian citizen.

entries.example: 天空中出現了一個不明物體。
entries.exampleEnglish: An unidentified object appeared in the sky.
entries.question: 你看過天空中的不明物體嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen an unidentified object in the sky?
entries.answer: 沒有，我從來沒看過不明物體。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never seen an unidentified object.

entries.example: 明天的會議改為下午三點。
entries.exampleEnglish: Tomorrow's meeting has been moved to 3 p.m.
entries.question: 如果下大雨，你的週末計畫會改為什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: If it pours with rain, what do your weekend plans change to?
entries.answer: 我會改為在家看電影。
entries.answerEnglish: I'll stay home and watch movies instead.

readings.questionPinyin: rú guǒ xià dà yǔ, nǐ de zhōu mò jì huà huì gǎi wéi shén me?

entries.example: 這一區是台北的商業中心。
entries.exampleEnglish: This area is Taipei's business center.
entries.question: 你喜歡住在商業區嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like living in a commercial district?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，商業區太吵了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, commercial districts are too noisy.

entries.example: 她工作很積極，老闆很喜歡她。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very proactive at work, and the boss likes her a lot.
entries.question: 你學中文的態度積極嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you proactive about learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我很積極，每天都練習。
entries.answerEnglish: Very. I practice every day.

entries.example: 他參加了一個登山協會。
entries.exampleEnglish: He joined a hiking association.
entries.question: 你有參加什麼協會嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you belong to any associations?
entries.answer: 我參加了台北的攝影協會。
entries.answerEnglish: I've joined a photography society in Taipei.

entries.example: 在台灣，一般人不能帶武器。
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taiwan, ordinary people can't carry weapons.
entries.question: 機場為什麼要檢查行李裡有沒有武器？
entries.questionEnglish: Why do airports check luggage for weapons?
entries.answer: 為了安全，機場不讓旅客帶武器上飛機。
entries.answerEnglish: For safety, airports don't let passengers take weapons on planes.

readings.questionPinyin: jī chǎng wèi shén me yào jiǎn chá xíng li lǐ yǒu méi yǒu wǔ qì?
readings.answerPinyin: wèi le ān quán, jī chǎng bú ràng lǚ kè dài wǔ qì shàng fēi jī.

entries.example: 會說英文是他的優勢。
entries.exampleEnglish: Speaking English is his advantage.
entries.question: 你覺得你找工作的優勢是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think your advantages are when job hunting?
entries.answer: 我的優勢是會說三種語言。
entries.answerEnglish: My advantage is that I speak three languages.

entries.example: 夢想很美，但現實很難。
entries.exampleEnglish: Dreams are beautiful, but reality is hard.
entries.question: 在台灣生活的現實，跟你想的一樣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is the reality of living in Taiwan what you expected?
entries.answer: 不太一樣，現實比我想的難。
entries.answerEnglish: Not quite. The reality is harder than I thought.

entries.example: 昨天電視上有總統候選人的辯論。
entries.exampleEnglish: There was a presidential candidates' debate on TV yesterday.
entries.question: 你喜歡跟朋友辯論嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like debating with friends?
entries.answer: 喜歡，但是我們不辯論政治。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but we don't debate politics.

entries.example: 這碗湯的味道很濃郁。
entries.exampleEnglish: This soup has a very rich flavor.
entries.question: 你喜歡味道濃郁的咖啡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like coffee with a rich flavor?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡很濃郁的黑咖啡。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like really rich black coffee.

entries.example: 新聞一直在報導這起事件。
entries.exampleEnglish: The news keeps reporting on this incident.
entries.question: 最近有什麼新聞事件讓你印象很深？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a recent news event that left a strong impression on you?
entries.answer: 最近的地震事件讓我印象很深。
entries.answerEnglish: The recent earthquake made a strong impression on me.

entries.example: 年輕一代比較少看電視。
entries.exampleEnglish: The younger generation watches less TV.
entries.question: 你這一代人跟父母那一代有什麼不同？
entries.questionEnglish: How is your generation different from your parents'?
entries.answer: 我們這一代比較常換工作。
entries.answerEnglish: Our generation changes jobs more often.

entries.example: 政府打算改革教育制度。
entries.exampleEnglish: The government plans to reform the education system.
entries.question: 你覺得你的國家最需要改革什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think your country most needs to reform?
entries.answer: 我覺得我們最需要改革交通。
entries.answerEnglish: I think we most need to reform transport.

entries.example: 我沒察覺到他不高興。
entries.exampleEnglish: I didn't notice he was upset.
entries.question: 你能察覺朋友心情不好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you tell when a friend is in a bad mood?
entries.answer: 可以，我很容易察覺朋友心情不好。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I easily sense when a friend is down.

entries.example: 這棟大樓有健身房和游泳池等設施。
entries.exampleEnglish: This building has facilities such as a gym and a pool.
entries.question: 你家附近有什麼運動設施？
entries.questionEnglish: What sports facilities are there near your home?
entries.answer: 我家附近有公園和籃球場等運動設施。
entries.answerEnglish: Near my home there are sports facilities like a park and basketball courts.

entries.example: 學語言的關鍵是多練習。
entries.exampleEnglish: The key to learning a language is practicing a lot.
entries.question: 你覺得學好中文的關鍵是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the key to learning Chinese well?
entries.answer: 我覺得關鍵是每天開口說。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the key is speaking out loud every day.

entries.example: 他參加了一場烹飪競賽。
entries.exampleEnglish: He entered a cooking competition.
entries.question: 你參加過什麼競賽嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever entered a competition?
entries.answer: 我參加過一次攝影競賽。
entries.answerEnglish: I once entered a photography contest.

entries.example: 這間美術館有很多有名的畫作。
entries.exampleEnglish: This art museum has many famous paintings.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪一幅畫作？
entries.questionEnglish: Which painting do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡梵谷的〈星夜〉這幅畫作。
entries.answerEnglish: I like Van Gogh's "The Starry Night" best.

entries.example: 老闆把水果放在秤上。
entries.exampleEnglish: The shopkeeper put the fruit on the scale.
entries.question: 你在家做菜會用秤嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a kitchen scale when you cook at home?
entries.answer: 會，做蛋糕的時候我會用秤。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I use a scale when I bake cakes.

entries.example: 她獨自去歐洲旅行。
entries.exampleEnglish: She traveled around Europe on her own.
entries.question: 你喜歡獨自去看電影嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like going to the movies alone?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常獨自去看電影。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often go to the movies by myself.

entries.example: 颱風對農民是很大的威脅。
entries.exampleEnglish: Typhoons are a big threat to farmers.
entries.question: 你覺得地球最大的威脅是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the biggest threat to the planet?
entries.answer: 我覺得氣候變遷是最大的威脅。
entries.answerEnglish: I think climate change is the biggest threat.

entries.example: 警察正在幫助受害者。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police are helping the victims.
entries.question: 詐騙電話的受害者常常是什麼人？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of people often fall victim to scam calls?
entries.answer: 很多受害者是老人。
entries.answerEnglish: Many of the victims are elderly people.

readings.questionPinyin: zhà piàn diàn huà de shòu hài zhě cháng cháng shì shén me rén?
readings.answerPinyin: hěn duō shòu hài zhě shì lǎo rén.

entries.example: 這次成功是大家的功勞。
entries.exampleEnglish: This success is thanks to everyone.
entries.question: 工作順利的時候，你覺得是誰的功勞？
entries.questionEnglish: When work goes well, who do you think deserves the credit?
entries.answer: 我覺得是整個團隊的功勞。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the whole team deserves the credit.

readings.questionPinyin: gōng zuò shùn lì de shí hòu, nǐ jué de shì shéi de gōng láo?

entries.example: 多運動可以增強體力。
entries.exampleEnglish: Exercising more can build up your stamina.
entries.question: 你怎麼增強自己的體力？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you build up your stamina?
entries.answer: 我每天跑步來增強體力。
entries.answerEnglish: I run every day to build up my stamina.

entries.example: 很多消費者喜歡在網路上買東西。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many consumers like shopping online.
entries.question: 你覺得自己是聰明的消費者嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're a smart consumer?
entries.answer: 是，我是很會比價的消費者。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm a consumer who's good at comparing prices.

entries.example: 台灣人對核能的看法很不同。
entries.exampleEnglish: People in Taiwan have very different views on nuclear power.
entries.question: 你支持用核能發電嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you support using nuclear power to generate electricity?
entries.answer: 我覺得核能有好處，也有風險。
entries.answerEnglish: I think nuclear power has benefits, but also risks.

entries.example: 航空公司罷工，很多班機取消了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The airline went on strike, and lots of flights were cancelled.
entries.question: 你遇過罷工嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been caught up in a strike?
entries.answer: 遇過，有一次火車罷工，我不能上班。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, once there was a train strike and I couldn't get to work.

entries.example: 她的夢想是當法官。
entries.exampleEnglish: Her dream is to become a judge.
entries.question: 你覺得當法官難嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think being a judge is hard?
entries.answer: 很難，法官一定要很公平。
entries.answerEnglish: Very hard. A judge has to be completely fair.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de dāng fǎ guān nán ma?

entries.example: 這家店的利潤不高。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop doesn't make much profit.
entries.question: 你覺得開咖啡店的利潤高嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think running a café is very profitable?
entries.answer: 我覺得利潤不高，但是很有趣。
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think the profit is high, but it's fun.

entries.example: 他找工作都依靠自己。
entries.exampleEnglish: He found his job entirely on his own.
entries.question: 你在台灣遇到問題時，依靠誰？
entries.questionEnglish: When you run into problems in Taiwan, who do you rely on?
entries.answer: 我常依靠我的台灣朋友。
entries.answerEnglish: I often rely on my Taiwanese friends.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān yù dào wèn tí shí, yī kào shéi?

entries.example: 我們的假期延長了兩天。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our holiday was extended by two days.
entries.question: 如果可以延長假期，你想去哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: If you could extend your holiday, where would you go?
entries.answer: 我想延長一個禮拜，去日本玩。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd extend it by a week and go to Japan.

entries.example: 這台電腦的功能很強大。
entries.exampleEnglish: This computer is very powerful.
entries.question: 你覺得你的手機功能強大嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your phone is powerful?
entries.answer: 很強大，拍照又快又清楚。
entries.answerEnglish: Very powerful. It takes photos fast and they're sharp.

entries.example: 今天高溫三十六度。
entries.exampleEnglish: Today's high is 36 degrees.
entries.question: 夏天高溫的時候，你會出門嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you go out when it's really hot in summer?
entries.answer: 高溫的時候，我盡量不出門。
entries.answerEnglish: When it's really hot, I try not to go out.

readings.answerPinyin: gāo wēn de shí hòu, wǒ jìn liàng bù chū mén.

entries.example: 火車上有很多放假的士兵。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of soldiers on leave on the train.
entries.question: 你的國家要當兵嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there military service in your country?
entries.answer: 不用，我們的士兵都是志願的。
entries.answerEnglish: No, our soldiers are all volunteers.

readings.examplePinyin: huǒ chē shàng yǒu hěn duō fàng jià de shì bīng.
readings.answerPinyin: bú yòng, wǒ men de shì bīng dōu shì zhì yuàn de.

entries.english: be present; be on the scene; be there
entries.example: 那時候我不在場。
entries.exampleEnglish: I wasn't there at the time.
entries.question: 開會時，老闆在場你會緊張嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: In meetings, do you get nervous when the boss is there?
entries.answer: 會，老闆在場我會很緊張。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I get really nervous when the boss is there.

entries.example: 這部電影有很多暴力畫面。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie has a lot of violent scenes.
entries.question: 為什麼有些電影不適合小孩看？
entries.questionEnglish: Why are some movies not suitable for children?
entries.answer: 因為有些電影有太多暴力畫面。
entries.answerEnglish: Because some movies have too many violent scenes.

readings.questionPinyin: wèi shén me yǒu xiē diàn yǐng bú shì hé xiǎo hái kàn?
readings.answerPinyin: yīn wèi yǒu xiē diàn yǐng yǒu tài duō bào lì huà miàn.

entries.example: 台中有很多工業區。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taichung has lots of industrial zones.
entries.question: 你的家鄉有很多工業嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there much industry in your hometown?
entries.answer: 沒有，我家鄉工業不多，農業比較多。
entries.answerEnglish: No, there's not much industry in my hometown. It's mostly farming.

entries.example: 他們為了錢起了爭執。
entries.exampleEnglish: They got into an argument over money.
entries.question: 你跟室友有過爭執嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had an argument with a roommate?
entries.answer: 有，我們為了打掃起過爭執。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we argued about the cleaning.

entries.example: 機車的煞車突然失靈了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The scooter's brakes suddenly failed.
entries.question: 你的手機曾經突然失靈嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your phone ever suddenly stopped working?
entries.answer: 有，我的手機上個月突然失靈了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my phone suddenly died last month.

readings.examplePinyin: jī chē de shā chē tú rán shī líng le.
readings.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī céng jīng tú rán shī líng ma?
readings.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de shǒu jī shàng gè yuè tú rán shī líng le.

entries.example: 颱風來之前，家裡先儲備了水和泡麵。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before the typhoon came, we stocked up on water and instant noodles at home.
entries.question: 颱風來之前，你會儲備什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you stock up on before a typhoon?
entries.answer: 我會儲備水、泡麵和電池。
entries.answerEnglish: I stock up on water, instant noodles and batteries.

entries.example: 水滾了，鍋子冒出很多白煙。
entries.exampleEnglish: The water's boiling, and lots of steam is coming out of the pot.
entries.question: 你最近有冒出什麼新想法嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have any new ideas popped into your head lately?
entries.answer: 有，我突然冒出想學衝浪的想法。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I suddenly had the idea to learn surfing.

readings.examplePinyin: shuǐ gǔn le, guō zi mào chū hěn duō bái yān.
readings.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ tú rán mào chū xiǎng xué chōng làng de xiǎng fǎ.

entries.example: 包裹裡的杯子在運送時損壞了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The cup in the package was damaged in transit.
entries.question: 你網購的東西有損壞過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has anything you bought online ever arrived damaged?
entries.answer: 有一次，杯子送來時就損壞了。
entries.answerEnglish: Once, a cup was already damaged when it arrived.

entries.example: 他因為酒駕被關進監獄。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was sent to prison for drunk driving.
entries.question: 在台灣，酒駕可能會被關進監獄嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: In Taiwan, can drunk drivers be sent to prison?
entries.answer: 會，嚴重的酒駕會被關進監獄。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, serious drunk-driving cases can lead to prison.

readings.questionPinyin: zài tái wān, jiǔ jià kě néng huì bèi guān jìn jiān yù ma?

entries.answer: 喜歡，站在山峰上看風景很美。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the view from a peak is beautiful.

entries.example: 太陽落下以後，天氣就涼了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Once the sun goes down, it gets cool.
entries.question: 你看過太陽從海上落下嗎？

entries.answer: 看過，在淡水看太陽落下很美。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, watching the sun go down in Tamsui is beautiful.

entries.exampleEnglish: Many companies are facing an economic crisis.

entries.answer: 有，去年公司發生了財務危機。

entries.exampleEnglish: When camping, we collected firewood to make a fire.
entries.question: 你露營時自己找過木柴嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever gathered your own firewood when camping?
entries.answer: 找過，我們撿了很多木柴來烤肉。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we collected lots of firewood for a barbecue.

entries.exampleEnglish: This new coworker has a lot of potential.

entries.answer: 我覺得我在語言方面有潛力。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I have potential with languages.

entries.exampleEnglish: He denied eating my cake.

entries.answer: 不會，我不會否認，我會道歉。

entries.exampleEnglish: Don't ignore small health problems.
entries.question: 你工作忙的時候會忽視健康嗎？

entries.answer: 會，忙的時候我常忽視健康。

entries.answer: 我喜歡喝溫熱的豆漿。
entries.answerEnglish: I like warm soy milk.

entries.answer: 通常兩三天就送達了。

entries.exampleEnglish: The government is promoting cycling to work.
entries.question: 你想向朋友推廣台灣的什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What about Taiwan would you like to promote to your friends?
entries.answer: 我想推廣台灣的夜市小吃。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to promote Taiwan's night market food.

entries.exampleEnglish: A police officer is directing traffic at the intersection.
entries.question: 你喜歡指揮別人做事嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like telling other people what to do?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我不喜歡指揮別人。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't like bossing people around.

entries.example: 我們從收容所收養了一隻狗。
entries.exampleEnglish: We adopted a dog from a shelter.
entries.question: 你想收養流浪貓嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to adopt a stray cat?
entries.answer: 想，我想收養一隻流浪貓。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to adopt a stray cat.

entries.example: 這家店的價錢很公道。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's prices are very fair.
entries.question: 你覺得夜市的價錢公道嗎？

entries.answer: 大部分很公道，不會太貴。
entries.answerEnglish: Mostly fair. They're not too expensive.

entries.answer: 喜歡，大銀幕看起來比較過癮。

entries.questionEnglish: Do you like soft, fluffy bread?

entries.exampleEnglish: This lawn is wide and open, great for a picnic.

entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer wide open spaces or lively places?
entries.answer: 我喜歡寬廣的地方，像海邊。
entries.answerEnglish: I like wide open places, like the beach.

entries.answer: 有，頭髮把浴室的水管堵住了。

entries.exampleEnglish: You can see wild monkeys in the mountains.

entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen wild animals in Taiwan?

entries.answer: 我覺得一天兩杯比較適當。

entries.exampleEnglish: This small town is surrounded by mountains.
entries.question: 你喜歡被大自然圍繞的感覺嗎？

entries.question: 你住在住宅區還是商業區？

entries.questionEnglish: Do you notice the small details in life?
entries.answer: 會，我很注意細小的地方。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I pay a lot of attention to small details.

entries.example: 你是透過什麼管道找到這份工作的？
entries.exampleEnglish: How did you find out about this job?
entries.question: 你都透過什麼管道看新聞？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you usually get your news?
entries.answer: 我看新聞的管道主要是網路。
entries.answerEnglish: I mainly get my news online.

readings.answerPinyin: wǒ kàn xīn wén de guǎn dào zhǔ yào shì wǎng lù.

entries.example: 他去年取得了永久居留證。
entries.exampleEnglish: He got permanent residency last year.
entries.question: 你想取得什麼證書？
entries.questionEnglish: What certificate would you like to get?
entries.answer: 我想取得華語文能力測驗的證書。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to get a TOCFL certificate.

entries.example: 辦簽證的流程有點複雜。
entries.exampleEnglish: The visa application process is a bit complicated.
entries.question: 你覺得辦居留證的流程麻煩嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find the ARC process a hassle?
entries.answer: 有點麻煩，流程比我想的多。
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. There are more steps than I expected.

entries.example: 我們的團隊很團結。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our team is very united.
entries.question: 你覺得你們國家的人團結嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think people in your country are united?
entries.answer: 遇到困難的時候，大家很團結。
entries.answerEnglish: When times are hard, everyone pulls together.

entries.english: stare at; keep an eye on
entries.example: 他一直盯著手機看。
entries.exampleEnglish: He keeps staring at his phone.
entries.question: 你在捷運上常盯著手機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often stare at your phone on the MRT?
entries.answer: 對，我常常盯著手機看新聞。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm often glued to my phone reading the news.

readings.examplePinyin: tā yì zhí dīng zhe shǒu jī kàn.
readings.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jié yùn shàng cháng dīng zhe shǒu jī ma?
readings.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ cháng cháng dīng zhe shǒu jī kàn xīn wén.

entries.example: 這個App在台灣有很多使用者。
entries.exampleEnglish: This app has lots of users in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你是哪個社群網站的使用者？
entries.questionEnglish: Which social media sites do you use?
entries.answer: 我是臉書的使用者。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm a Facebook user.

entries.example: 我們合作很久了，很有默契。
entries.exampleEnglish: We've worked together for a long time, so we understand each other without words.
entries.question: 你和誰最有默契？
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you have the best unspoken understanding with?
entries.answer: 我和我太太最有默契。
entries.answerEnglish: My wife and I understand each other best.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ hé shéi zuì yǒu mò qì?

entries.english: associate; think of; connect in mind
entries.example: 看到芒果，我就聯想到台南。
entries.exampleEnglish: Whenever I see mangoes, I think of Tainan.
entries.question: 提到台灣，你會聯想到什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: When Taiwan comes up, what do you think of?
entries.answer: 我會聯想到夜市和珍珠奶茶。
entries.answerEnglish: I think of night markets and bubble tea.

entries.example: 他對自己的工作有很強的信念。
entries.exampleEnglish: He has a strong belief in his work.
entries.question: 你有什麼人生信念？
entries.questionEnglish: What beliefs do you live by?
entries.answer: 我的信念是要對別人好。
entries.answerEnglish: My belief is that you should be kind to others.

entries.example: 很多公司捐助這個活動。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many companies contribute to this event.
entries.question: 你捐助過慈善團體嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever donated to a charity?
entries.answer: 有，我每個月捐助一個動物協會。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I donate to an animal welfare group every month.

entries.example: 演唱會結束後有免費接駁車。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are free shuttle buses after the concert.
entries.question: 你搭過活動的接駁車嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever taken a shuttle bus to an event?
entries.answer: 有，我搭接駁車去過演唱會。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've taken a shuttle bus to a concert.

entries.example: 這家公司僱用了很多外國人。
entries.exampleEnglish: This company employs a lot of foreigners.
entries.question: 你的公司常僱用外國人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company often hire foreigners?
entries.answer: 常常，我們僱用了很多外國人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we've hired a lot of foreigners.

entries.example: 這家咖啡店的擺設很特別。
entries.exampleEnglish: The decor in this coffee shop is really unusual.
entries.question: 你喜歡你家的擺設嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like the way your home is furnished?
entries.answer: 喜歡，擺設都是我自己決定的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I chose all the furnishings myself.

entries.example: 失業對他是很大的打擊。
entries.exampleEnglish: Losing his job was a big blow to him.
entries.question: 你遇過很大的打擊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever suffered a big blow?
entries.answer: 有，被裁員對我是很大的打擊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, being laid off was a big blow to me.

readings.examplePinyin: shī yè duì tā shì hěn dà de dǎ jí.
readings.questionPinyin: nǐ yù guò hěn dà de dǎ jí ma?
readings.answerPinyin: yǒu, bèi cái yuán duì wǒ shì hěn dà de dǎ jí.

entries.example: 沒有冷氣的夏天像地獄。
entries.exampleEnglish: Summer without air conditioning is like hell.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的夏天像地獄嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think summer in Taiwan is like hell?
entries.answer: 有一點，太熱了，像地獄一樣。
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. It's so hot, it's like hell.

entries.example: 喝酒以後，酒精會留在體內很久。
entries.exampleEnglish: After you drink, the alcohol stays in your body for a long time.
entries.question: 你體內缺水時會怎麼樣？
entries.questionEnglish: What happens to you when your body is short of water?
entries.answer: 我體內缺水的時候會頭痛。
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm dehydrated, I get a headache.

entries.english: be engaged in; work in (a field)
entries.example: 他從事教育工作十年了。
entries.exampleEnglish: He has worked in education for ten years.
entries.question: 你從事什麼工作？
entries.questionEnglish: What line of work are you in?
entries.answer: 我從事軟體設計。
entries.answerEnglish: I work in software design.

entries.example: 請關掉你的電子裝置。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please turn off your electronic devices.
entries.question: 你家裡有幾個電子裝置？
entries.questionEnglish: How many electronic devices do you have at home?
entries.answer: 我有手機、電腦和平板，三個裝置。
entries.answerEnglish: I have a phone, a computer and a tablet: three devices.

entries.example: 他為了學業來台灣。
entries.exampleEnglish: He came to Taiwan for his studies.
entries.question: 你學生時代的學業壓力大嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Was there a lot of academic pressure when you were a student?
entries.answer: 很大，我那時候學業壓力很大。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my studies were very stressful back then.

entries.example: 我的手機容量不夠了。
entries.exampleEnglish: My phone is running out of storage.
entries.question: 你的手機容量夠用嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your phone have enough storage?
entries.answer: 不夠，我的手機容量快滿了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my phone's storage is almost full.

entries.example: 我的快篩結果是陰性。
entries.exampleEnglish: My rapid test came back negative.
entries.question: 快篩結果是陰性，代表什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What does a negative rapid test result mean?
entries.answer: 陰性代表沒有被感染。
entries.answerEnglish: Negative means you're not infected.

readings.questionPinyin: kuài shāi jié guǒ shì yīn xìng, dài biǎo shén me?
readings.answerPinyin: yīn xìng dài biǎo méi yǒu bèi gǎn rǎn.

entries.example: 我喜歡探索台北的小巷子。
entries.exampleEnglish: I like exploring Taipei's little alleys.
entries.question: 你最想探索台灣哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where in Taiwan would you most like to explore?
entries.answer: 我最想探索東部的山。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd most like to explore the mountains in the east.

entries.example: 我的雇主幫我申請工作證。
entries.exampleEnglish: My employer applied for my work permit for me.
entries.question: 你的雇主對你好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your employer good to you?
entries.answer: 很好，我的雇主很照顧我。
entries.answerEnglish: Very good. My employer looks after me well.

entries.example: 我最初來台灣只想住一年。
entries.exampleEnglish: When I first came to Taiwan, I only planned to stay a year.
entries.question: 你最初為什麼來台灣？
entries.questionEnglish: Why did you originally come to Taiwan?
entries.answer: 最初是為了學中文。
entries.answerEnglish: At first it was to learn Chinese.

readings.examplePinyin: wǒ zuì chū lái tái wān zhǐ xiǎng zhù yì nián.

entries.example: 他總是有最新的美食情報。
entries.exampleEnglish: He always has the latest tips on where to eat.
entries.question: 你常從哪裡得到美食情報？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you usually get your food tips?
entries.answer: 我常從網路社團得到美食情報。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually get food tips from online groups.

entries.example: 開會的時候，大家都很沉默。
entries.exampleEnglish: In the meeting, everyone was very quiet.
entries.question: 你在會議上常保持沉默嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually stay silent in meetings?
entries.answer: 常常，我開會時都很沉默。
entries.answerEnglish: Usually. I'm very quiet in meetings.

entries.example: 我只想過平凡的生活。
entries.exampleEnglish: I just want to live an ordinary life.
entries.question: 你想過平凡的生活嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you want to live an ordinary life?
entries.answer: 想，平凡的生活最幸福。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, an ordinary life is the happiest.

readings.examplePinyin: wǒ zhǐ xiǎng guò píng fán de shēng huó.

entries.example: 台北的房租我還負擔得起。
entries.exampleEnglish: I can still afford the rent in Taipei.
entries.question: 你負擔得起台北的房租嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you afford rent in Taipei?
entries.answer: 還可以，我負擔得起小套房。
entries.answerEnglish: More or less. I can afford a small studio.

readings.examplePinyin: tái běi de fáng zū wǒ hái fù dān de qǐ.
readings.questionPinyin: nǐ fù dān de qǐ tái běi de fáng zū ma?
readings.answerPinyin: hái kě yǐ, wǒ fù dān de qǐ xiǎo tào fáng.

entries.example: 在家工作是新的趨勢。
entries.exampleEnglish: Working from home is the new trend.
entries.question: 你覺得現在有什麼新趨勢？
entries.questionEnglish: What new trends do you see these days?
entries.answer: 我覺得人工智慧是最大的趨勢。
entries.answerEnglish: I think AI is the biggest trend.

entries.example: 每個人對成功的定義都不一樣。
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone defines success differently.
entries.question: 你對成功的定義是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you define success?
entries.answer: 我對成功的定義是每天都很快樂。
entries.answerEnglish: My definition of success is being happy every day.

entries.example: 我的腳踏車鏈條掉了。
entries.exampleEnglish: My bike chain came off.
entries.question: 你的腳踏車鏈條掉過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your bike chain ever come off?
entries.answer: 掉過，我自己把鏈條裝回去。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I put the chain back on myself.

entries.example: 他是典型的台北上班族。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a typical Taipei office worker.
entries.question: 你覺得你是典型的上班族嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're a typical office worker?
entries.answer: 是，我是很典型的上班族。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm a very typical office worker.

entries.example: 他說音樂是他的靈魂。
entries.exampleEnglish: He says music is his soul.
entries.question: 你相信人有靈魂嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe people have souls?
entries.answer: 我相信人有靈魂。
entries.answerEnglish: I believe people have souls.

entries.example: 很難預測颱風會不會來。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's hard to predict whether the typhoon will come.
entries.question: 你能預測自己五年後在哪裡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you predict where you'll be in five years?
entries.answer: 很難預測，可能還在台灣。
entries.answerEnglish: It's hard to say. Maybe still in Taiwan.

entries.example: 書放在書架的上層。
entries.exampleEnglish: The books are on the top shelf.
entries.question: 你家冰箱的上層放什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you keep on the top shelf of your fridge?
entries.answer: 上層放飲料和水果。
entries.answerEnglish: Drinks and fruit go on the top shelf.

entries.example: 老闆把工作分配給大家。
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss assigned the work to everyone.
entries.question: 你怎麼分配你的薪水？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you divide up your salary?
entries.answer: 我把一半的薪水分配給房租。
entries.answerEnglish: I put half my salary towards rent.

readings.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn bǎ gōng zuò fēn pèi gěi dà jiā.
readings.answerPinyin: wǒ bǎ yí bàn de xīn shuǐ fēn pèi gěi fáng zū.

entries.example: 他辭掉工作，去追求他的夢想。
entries.exampleEnglish: He quit his job to pursue his dream.
entries.question: 你現在在追求什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What are you pursuing right now?
entries.answer: 我在追求更好的生活。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm pursuing a better life.

entries.example: 這家咖啡店的裝潢很獨特。
entries.exampleEnglish: This coffee shop has a very distinctive interior.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣有什麼獨特的文化？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is unique about Taiwanese culture?
entries.answer: 我覺得夜市文化很獨特。
entries.answerEnglish: I think night market culture is unique.

entries.example: 這杯奶茶茶和奶的比例剛好。
entries.exampleEnglish: This milk tea has just the right ratio of tea to milk.
entries.question: 你的公司男女比例怎麼樣？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the ratio of men to women at your company?
entries.answer: 男女比例差不多一半一半。
entries.answerEnglish: It's about half and half.

entries.example: 我跑完步，胸口有點悶。
entries.exampleEnglish: After my run, my chest feels a bit tight.
entries.question: 你緊張時胸口會悶嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your chest feel tight when you're nervous?
entries.answer: 會，我緊張時胸口很悶。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my chest feels tight when I'm nervous.

entries.example: 運動前要先伸展一下。
entries.exampleEnglish: You should stretch a bit before exercising.
entries.question: 你運動前會伸展嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you stretch before you exercise?
entries.answer: 會，我每次都伸展十分鐘。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always stretch for ten minutes.

entries.example: 博愛座要讓老人優先坐。
entries.exampleEnglish: Elderly people get priority on the priority seats.
entries.question: 你生活中什麼最優先？
entries.questionEnglish: What comes first in your life?
entries.answer: 家人對我來說最優先。
entries.answerEnglish: My family comes first for me.

entries.example: 他每天去健身房練肌肉。
entries.exampleEnglish: He goes to the gym every day to build muscle.
entries.question: 你運動完肌肉會痠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do your muscles ache after you exercise?
entries.answer: 會，我的肌肉常常很痠。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my muscles are often sore.

entries.example: 這張木頭桌子很結實。
entries.exampleEnglish: This wooden table is very sturdy.
entries.question: 你喜歡買結實的家具嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like buying sturdy furniture?
entries.answer: 喜歡，結實的家具可以用很久。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, sturdy furniture lasts a long time.

entries.example: 請不要把東西放在通道上。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please don't leave things in the passageway.
entries.question: 你上班會走地下通道嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you walk through underground passages on your way to work?
entries.answer: 會，我每天走捷運的地下通道。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I walk through the MRT underground passage every day.

entries.example: 老闆在會議上表揚了她。
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss praised her in the meeting.
entries.question: 你被公司表揚過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your company ever commended you?
entries.answer: 有，去年我被公司表揚過。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the company commended me last year.

entries.example: 他今天的會議缺席了。
entries.exampleEnglish: He missed today's meeting.
entries.question: 你上次缺席中文課是為什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: Why did you miss your last Chinese class?
entries.answer: 我那天生病，所以缺席了。
entries.answerEnglish: I was sick that day, so I missed it.

entries.example: 台灣有免費的乳房攝影檢查。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan offers free mammogram screening.
entries.question: 你的國家會提醒女生做乳房檢查嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country remind women to have breast checks?
entries.answer: 會，政府常提醒女生做乳房檢查。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the government often reminds women to get breast checks.

entries.example: 地球是一顆行星。
entries.exampleEnglish: The Earth is a planet.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪一顆行星？
entries.questionEnglish: Which planet do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡土星這顆行星。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite planet is Saturn.

entries.example: 昨天晚上下了一場暴風雨。
entries.exampleEnglish: There was a storm last night.
entries.question: 你遇過很大的暴風雨嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been caught in a big storm?
entries.answer: 遇過，颱風天的暴風雨很可怕。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the storms during typhoons are scary.

entries.example: 這個月的開支太大了。
entries.exampleEnglish: My spending this month was too high.
entries.question: 你每個月最大的開支是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What is your biggest expense each month?
entries.answer: 我最大的開支是房租。
entries.answerEnglish: My biggest expense is rent.

entries.example: 他每週在雜誌上寫一個專欄。
entries.exampleEnglish: He writes a column in a magazine every week.
entries.question: 你常看網路上的專欄嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often read columns online?
entries.answer: 常看，我喜歡看美食專欄。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like reading food columns.

entries.example: 這個碗有一個小缺口。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bowl has a small chip.
entries.question: 你的杯子有缺口還會用嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you still use a cup if it has a chip?
entries.answer: 不會，有缺口的杯子我會丟掉。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I throw away chipped cups.

entries.example: 加班一個禮拜，我非常疲憊。
entries.exampleEnglish: After a week of overtime, I'm exhausted.
entries.question: 你什麼時候覺得最疲憊？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you feel most exhausted?
entries.answer: 星期五晚上我最疲憊。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most exhausted on Friday nights.

entries.example: 在這裡擺攤需要許可證。
entries.exampleEnglish: You need a permit to set up a stall here.
entries.question: 你在台灣申請過什麼許可證？
entries.questionEnglish: What permits have you applied for in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我申請過工作許可證。
entries.answerEnglish: I've applied for a work permit.

entries.example: 今天捷運這麼空，真不尋常。
entries.exampleEnglish: The MRT is so empty today. That's really unusual.
entries.question: 你最近遇到什麼不尋常的事？
entries.questionEnglish: Has anything unusual happened to you recently?
entries.answer: 十月還這麼熱，我覺得很不尋常。
entries.answerEnglish: It's still this hot in October. I find that really unusual.

entries.example: 我忘了媽媽的生日，覺得很內疚。
entries.exampleEnglish: I forgot my mom's birthday and feel really guilty.
entries.question: 你最近有沒有覺得內疚的事？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there anything you've felt guilty about lately?
entries.answer: 我太久沒打電話給爸媽，覺得很內疚。
entries.answerEnglish: I haven't called my parents in ages, and I feel guilty about it.

entries.example: 這是我們公司的核心技術。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is our company's core technology.
entries.question: 你覺得一個家庭的核心是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the core of a family?
entries.answer: 我覺得家庭的核心是互相尊重。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the core of a family is mutual respect.

entries.example: 這隻狗被主人遺棄在路邊。
entries.exampleEnglish: This dog was abandoned by the roadside by its owner.
entries.question: 你看過被遺棄的動物嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen an abandoned animal?
entries.answer: 看過，我家的貓就是被遺棄的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. My cat was actually abandoned.

entries.example: 這家製造商在台中有工廠。
entries.exampleEnglish: This manufacturer has a factory in Taichung.
entries.question: 你知道哪些台灣的製造商？
entries.questionEnglish: Which Taiwanese manufacturers do you know?
entries.answer: 我知道捷安特，它是腳踏車製造商。
entries.answerEnglish: I know Giant. It's a bicycle manufacturer.

entries.example: 這部電影的緊張感很強。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie is full of tension.
entries.question: 你喜歡有緊張感的電影嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like movies with a lot of suspense?
entries.answer: 喜歡，有緊張感的電影比較好看。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, suspenseful movies are more fun to watch.

entries.example: 醫生建議我去看皮膚科的專科醫師。
entries.exampleEnglish: The doctor suggested I see a dermatology specialist.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過專科醫師嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a specialist in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，我看過耳鼻喉科的專科醫師。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen an ear, nose and throat specialist.

entries.example: 警察正在找這場車禍的目擊者。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police are looking for witnesses to the car accident.
entries.question: 警察為什麼要找車禍的目擊者？
entries.questionEnglish: Why do the police look for witnesses to a car accident?
entries.answer: 因為目擊者知道當時發生了什麼事。
entries.answerEnglish: Because witnesses know what happened at the time.

readings.examplePinyin: jǐng chá zhèng zài zhǎo zhè chǎng chē huò de mù jí zhě.
readings.questionPinyin: jǐng chá wèi shén me yào zhǎo chē huò de mù jí zhě?
readings.answerPinyin: yīn wèi mù jí zhě zhī dào dāng shí fā shēng le shén me shì.

entries.example: 他一直看手錶，暗示我們該走了。
entries.exampleEnglish: He kept looking at his watch, hinting that we should leave.
entries.question: 你拒絕別人時，會用暗示的方式嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you turn someone down, do you drop hints?
entries.answer: 不會，我不喜歡暗示，我會直接說。
entries.answerEnglish: No. I don't like hinting; I just say it directly.

entries.example: 這張桌子很穩固，不會晃。
entries.exampleEnglish: This table is very solid; it doesn't wobble.
entries.question: 你覺得穩固的友誼需要什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think a solid friendship needs?
entries.answer: 我覺得穩固的友誼需要信任。
entries.answerEnglish: I think a solid friendship needs trust.

entries.example: 她對自己做的蛋糕很自豪。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very proud of the cakes she makes.
entries.question: 你最自豪的事是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What are you most proud of?
entries.answer: 我最自豪的是我學會了中文。
entries.answerEnglish: What I'm proudest of is that I learned Chinese.

entries.example: 這座橋是用鋼做的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bridge is made of steel.
entries.question: 你家的鍋子是不鏽鋼的嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are the pots in your home stainless steel?
entries.answer: 對，我家的鍋子都是不鏽鋼的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, all the pots at my place are stainless steel.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de guō zi shì bú xiù gāng de ma?
readings.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ jiā de guō zi dōu shì bú xiù gāng de.

entries.example: 下週在台北有一場國際大會。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's an international convention in Taipei next week.
entries.question: 你參加過什麼大會嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever attended any big conferences?
entries.answer: 參加過，我去年參加過一場科技大會。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I attended a tech conference last year.

entries.example: 這個計畫的週期是三個月。
entries.exampleEnglish: This project runs in three-month cycles.
entries.question: 你多久換一次手機？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you change your phone?
entries.answer: 我換手機的週期大概是三年。
entries.answerEnglish: I change phones about every three years.

entries.example: 冬天皮膚很乾，要擦乳霜。
entries.exampleEnglish: Skin gets dry in winter, so you need to put on cream.
entries.question: 你冬天會擦乳霜嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you put on moisturizer in winter?
entries.answer: 會，我每天晚上都擦乳霜。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I put on cream every night.

entries.example: 你知道珍珠奶茶的起源嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Do you know the origin of bubble tea?
entries.question: 你知道你名字的起源嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know the origin of your name?
entries.answer: 知道，我的名字起源於希臘文。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my name comes from Greek.

entries.example: 皮膚不要在太陽下暴露太久。
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't expose your skin to the sun for too long.
entries.question: 夏天你會怎麼保護皮膚？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you protect your skin in summer?
entries.answer: 我會擦防曬，不讓皮膚暴露在陽光下。
entries.answerEnglish: I wear sunscreen and keep my skin out of the sun.

entries.example: 他終於拿到了台灣的永久居留。
entries.exampleEnglish: He finally got permanent residency in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你想在台灣永久住下來嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to live in Taiwan permanently?
entries.answer: 想，我打算申請永久居留。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I plan to apply for permanent residency.

entries.example: 他看起來很冷靜，其實內心很緊張。
entries.exampleEnglish: He looks calm, but inside he's very nervous.
entries.question: 你內心最大的願望是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What is your deepest wish?
entries.answer: 我內心最大的願望是家人都健康。
entries.answerEnglish: My deepest wish is for my family to stay healthy.

entries.example: 這個山谷的風景很美。
entries.exampleEnglish: The scenery in this valley is beautiful.
entries.question: 你喜歡在山谷裡露營嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like camping in valleys?
entries.answer: 喜歡，山谷裡很安靜，晚上可以看星星。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, valleys are quiet, and you can see the stars at night.

entries.example: 他很少表達自己的情感。
entries.exampleEnglish: He rarely expresses his emotions.
entries.question: 你容易表達自己的情感嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find it easy to express your emotions?
entries.answer: 不太容易，我很少表達情感。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I rarely show my feelings.

entries.example: 我爸爸每個月都領退休金。
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad receives a pension every month.
entries.question: 你覺得只靠退休金生活夠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a pension alone is enough to live on?
entries.answer: 不夠，只靠退休金生活很難。
entries.answerEnglish: No, it's hard to live on just a pension.

entries.example: 加了糖以後，要攪拌一下。
entries.exampleEnglish: After adding the sugar, give it a stir.
entries.question: 你喝咖啡會加糖攪拌嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you add sugar and stir your coffee?
entries.answer: 不會，我喝黑咖啡，不用攪拌。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I drink black coffee, so I don't need to stir it.

entries.example: 智慧型手機帶來了一場生活革命。
entries.exampleEnglish: Smartphones brought about a revolution in daily life.
entries.question: 你覺得哪個發明是一場革命？
entries.questionEnglish: Which invention do you think was a revolution?
entries.answer: 我覺得網路是一場很大的革命。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the internet was a huge revolution.

entries.example: 他總是用命令的口氣跟我說話。
entries.exampleEnglish: He always talks to me in a commanding tone.
entries.question: 你喜歡別人命令你做事嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like being ordered to do things?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我不喜歡被命令。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't like being ordered around.

entries.example: 我們經由香港飛回台北。
entries.exampleEnglish: We flew back to Taipei via Hong Kong.
entries.question: 你是怎麼找到現在的工作的？
entries.questionEnglish: How did you find your current job?
entries.answer: 我是經由朋友介紹找到的。
entries.answerEnglish: I found it through a friend's introduction.

entries.english: outlook on life; philosophy of life
entries.example: 住在國外改變了我的人生觀。
entries.exampleEnglish: Living abroad changed my outlook on life.
entries.question: 你的人生觀是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's your philosophy of life?
entries.answer: 我的人生觀是開心過每一天。
entries.answerEnglish: My philosophy of life is to enjoy every day.

entries.example: 在捷運上，請讓座給年長的乘客。
entries.exampleEnglish: On the MRT, please give your seat to elderly passengers.
entries.question: 你家裡最年長的人是誰？
entries.questionEnglish: Who is the oldest person in your family?
entries.answer: 我家最年長的是我奶奶。
entries.answerEnglish: The oldest in my family is my grandma.

entries.example: 山上的溪流很乾淨，可以看到魚。
entries.exampleEnglish: The mountain stream is so clean you can see the fish.
entries.question: 你夏天喜歡去溪流玩水嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like playing in streams in summer?
entries.answer: 喜歡，在溪流玩水很涼快。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, splashing around in a stream is nice and cool.

entries.example: 這家餐廳的名聲很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant has a very good reputation.
entries.question: 你覺得名聲重要嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think reputation matters?
entries.answer: 重要，但我覺得名聲不是一切。
entries.answerEnglish: It matters, but I don't think reputation is everything.

entries.example: 台北的工作機會多，但是競爭激烈。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei has lots of jobs, but the competition is fierce.
entries.question: 你的行業競爭激烈嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your industry very competitive?
entries.answer: 對，我們這一行競爭激烈。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my line of work is very competitive.

entries.example: 這種物質對身體不好。
entries.exampleEnglish: This substance is bad for your health.
entries.question: 你覺得物質生活重要嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think material comfort is important?
entries.answer: 我覺得物質生活不是最重要的。
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think material comfort is the most important thing.

entries.example: 我們週末去國家戲劇院看音樂劇。
entries.exampleEnglish: We're going to the National Theater to see a musical this weekend.
entries.question: 你看過什麼音樂劇？
entries.questionEnglish: What musicals have you seen?
entries.answer: 我在倫敦看過一部很棒的音樂劇。
entries.answerEnglish: I saw a great musical in London.

entries.example: 她看到蟑螂就大聲尖叫。
entries.exampleEnglish: She screamed when she saw the cockroach.
entries.question: 你看到什麼會尖叫？
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you scream when you see it?
entries.answer: 我看到老鼠一定會尖叫。
entries.answerEnglish: I always scream when I see a mouse.

entries.example: 這個游泳池的深度是兩公尺。
entries.exampleEnglish: This pool is two meters deep.
entries.question: 你喜歡有深度的電影嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like movies with depth?
entries.answer: 喜歡，有深度的電影讓我想很多。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, deep movies make me think a lot.

entries.example: 工作太多，我一個人應付不來。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's too much work for me to handle alone.
entries.question: 工作壓力大的時候，你怎麼應付？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you cope when work gets stressful?
entries.answer: 我會先去運動，再回來慢慢應付。
entries.answerEnglish: I go work out first, then come back and deal with it bit by bit.

entries.example: 今年颱風少，芒果的產量很高。
entries.exampleEnglish: There were few typhoons this year, so the mango harvest is big.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪種水果產量最多？
entries.questionEnglish: Which fruit do you think Taiwan produces the most of?
entries.answer: 我覺得香蕉的產量最多。
entries.answerEnglish: I think bananas have the biggest output.

entries.example: 他們把老房子改造成咖啡廳。
entries.exampleEnglish: They turned an old house into a café.
entries.question: 如果可以，你想怎麼改造你的房間？
entries.questionEnglish: If you could, how would you remodel your room?
entries.answer: 我想把房間改造成一間小書房。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to turn my room into a small study.

entries.example: 這次升職是你應得的。
entries.exampleEnglish: You deserve this promotion.
entries.question: 你覺得你應得更多假期嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you deserve more vacation time?
entries.answer: 當然，我工作這麼辛苦，這是我應得的。
entries.answerEnglish: Of course. I work so hard; I've earned it.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ yīng dé gèng duō jià qí ma?

entries.example: 這座老廟已經修復好了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This old temple has been restored.
entries.question: 你會自己修復舊家具嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you restore old furniture yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我修復過一張舊椅子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once restored an old chair.

entries.example: 這位神父在台灣住了三十年。
entries.exampleEnglish: This priest has lived in Taiwan for thirty years.
entries.question: 你認識任何神父嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know any priests?
entries.answer: 認識，我家附近教堂的神父很友善。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the priest at the church near my home is very friendly.

entries.example: 以前猴硐的人靠挖煤生活。
entries.exampleEnglish: People in Houtong used to make a living mining coal.
entries.question: 你覺得還應該用煤發電嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think we should still use coal to generate electricity?
entries.answer: 我覺得不應該再用煤發電了。
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think we should use coal for power anymore.

entries.example: 這次颱風的風雨很猛烈。
entries.exampleEnglish: The wind and rain from this typhoon were fierce.
entries.question: 你遇過很猛烈的颱風嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been through a really fierce typhoon?
entries.answer: 遇過，去年那個颱風特別猛烈。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last year's typhoon was especially fierce.

entries.example: 山上的空氣很純淨。
entries.exampleEnglish: The air in the mountains is very pure.
entries.question: 你覺得哪裡的空氣最純淨？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think the air is purest?
entries.answer: 我覺得合歡山的空氣最純淨。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the air on Hehuan Mountain is the purest.

entries.example: 他沒受過正規的音樂訓練。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's never had formal music training.
entries.question: 你上過正規的中文課嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever taken formal Chinese classes?
entries.answer: 上過，我在師大上過正規的中文課。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I took formal Chinese classes at NTNU.

entries.example: 他努力控制心裡的怒氣。
entries.exampleEnglish: He tried hard to control his anger.
entries.question: 你生氣的時候怎麼消除怒氣？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you get rid of your anger when you're mad?
entries.answer: 我會去跑步，讓怒氣慢慢消失。
entries.answerEnglish: I go for a run and let my anger fade.

entries.example: 每當下雨，我就想喝熱湯。
entries.exampleEnglish: Whenever it rains, I feel like having hot soup.
entries.question: 每當你心情不好，你會做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do whenever you're in a bad mood?
entries.answer: 每當心情不好，我就去河邊散步。
entries.answerEnglish: Whenever I'm in a bad mood, I go for a walk by the river.

entries.example: 騎機車不戴安全帽是違法的。
entries.exampleEnglish: Riding a scooter without a helmet is illegal.
entries.question: 在你的國家，什麼事是違法的？
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, what is illegal?
entries.answer: 在我的國家，在路上喝酒是違法的。
entries.answerEnglish: In my country, drinking in the street is illegal.

entries.example: 健康比財富更重要。
entries.exampleEnglish: Health is more important than wealth.
entries.question: 你覺得財富能帶來快樂嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think wealth brings happiness?
entries.answer: 我覺得財富不一定能帶來快樂。
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think wealth necessarily brings happiness.

entries.example: 我抵擋不了雞排的香味。
entries.exampleEnglish: I can't resist the smell of fried chicken cutlets.
entries.question: 你抵擋得了甜點的誘惑嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you resist the temptation of desserts?
entries.answer: 抵擋不了，我每天都要吃甜點。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I have to have dessert every day.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ dǐ dǎng de liǎo tián diǎn de yòu huò ma?

entries.example: 發票上的總金額是三百五十元。
entries.exampleEnglish: The total on the receipt is 350 NT dollars.
entries.question: 你這個月網購的總金額是多少？
entries.questionEnglish: How much have you spent shopping online this month in total?
entries.answer: 總金額大概五千塊吧。
entries.answerEnglish: The total is about five thousand dollars, I think.

entries.example: 在台灣，紅色象徵好運。
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taiwan, red symbolizes good luck.
entries.question: 在你的國家，什麼顏色象徵好運？
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, what color symbolizes good luck?
entries.answer: 在我的國家，綠色象徵好運。
entries.answerEnglish: In my country, green symbolizes good luck.

entries.example: 孩子們在公園盪鞦韆。
entries.exampleEnglish: The kids are on the swings in the park.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡盪鞦韆嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you like playing on swings as a kid?
entries.answer: 很喜歡，我常常把鞦韆盪得很高。
entries.answerEnglish: I loved it. I used to swing really high.

entries.example: 去山上走走，心靈會比較平靜。
entries.exampleEnglish: A walk in the mountains brings peace of mind.
entries.question: 你怎麼讓自己的心靈平靜？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you find peace of mind?
entries.answer: 我會去寺廟坐一坐，讓心靈平靜。
entries.answerEnglish: I go sit in a temple for a while to calm my mind.

entries.example: 臭豆腐的氣味很特別。
entries.exampleEnglish: Stinky tofu has a very distinctive smell.
entries.question: 你最喜歡什麼氣味？
entries.questionEnglish: What's your favorite smell?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡剛煮好的咖啡的氣味。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite smell is freshly brewed coffee.

entries.example: 台北的生活步調很快。
entries.exampleEnglish: Life in Taipei moves at a fast pace.
entries.question: 你喜歡快步調還是慢步調的生活？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer a fast-paced or slow-paced life?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡慢步調的生活，像台東那樣。
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer a slower pace of life, like in Taitung.

entries.example: 小狗把骨頭埋在院子裡。
entries.exampleEnglish: The puppy buried its bone in the yard.
entries.question: 你小時候埋過什麼東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you ever bury anything as a kid?
entries.answer: 埋過，我在樹下埋過一個小盒子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I buried a little box under a tree.

entries.example: 起初我聽不懂台語，現在懂一點了。
entries.exampleEnglish: At first I couldn't understand Taiwanese, but now I understand a little.
entries.question: 你起初為什麼來台灣？
entries.questionEnglish: Why did you come to Taiwan in the first place?
entries.answer: 我起初是來台灣學中文的。
entries.answerEnglish: I originally came to Taiwan to study Chinese.

entries.example: 她的興趣很廣泛。
entries.exampleEnglish: She has a wide range of interests.
entries.question: 你的興趣廣泛嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a wide range of interests?
entries.answer: 很廣泛，我喜歡運動、音樂和旅行。
entries.answerEnglish: Very wide. I like sports, music and travel.

entries.example: 最近的天氣很極端，一下熱一下冷。
entries.exampleEnglish: The weather's been extreme lately: hot one minute, cold the next.
entries.question: 你覺得自己的想法極端嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your views are extreme?
entries.answer: 不會，我的想法一點也不極端。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my views aren't extreme at all.

entries.example: 一直找不到工作，讓他很焦慮。
entries.exampleEnglish: Not being able to find a job has made him very anxious.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你焦慮？
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you anxious?
entries.answer: 工作太多的時候，我會很焦慮。
entries.answerEnglish: I get anxious when I have too much work.

entries.example: 用了這瓶洗髮精，頭髮變得很滑順。
entries.exampleEnglish: After using this shampoo, my hair became very silky.
entries.question: 你喜歡口感滑順的布丁嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like pudding with a smooth texture?
entries.answer: 喜歡，越滑順的布丁越好吃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the smoother the pudding, the better.

entries.example: 這件毛衣摸起來很粗糙。
entries.exampleEnglish: This sweater feels rough.
entries.question: 你的手冬天會變粗糙嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do your hands get rough in winter?
entries.answer: 會，冬天我的手很粗糙，要擦乳液。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my hands get rough in winter, so I use lotion.

entries.example: 這次颱風讓很多作物都壞了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This typhoon ruined a lot of crops.
entries.question: 你的家鄉主要種什麼作物？
entries.questionEnglish: What crops are mainly grown in your hometown?
entries.answer: 我的家鄉主要的作物是玉米。
entries.answerEnglish: The main crop in my hometown is corn.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng zhǔ yào zhòng shén me zuò wù?

entries.example: 夏天用電太多，電力負荷很大。
entries.exampleEnglish: In summer we use so much electricity that the grid is under heavy load.
entries.question: 你最近的工作量負荷得了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you handle your workload lately?
entries.answer: 有點負荷不了，我每天都加班。
entries.answerEnglish: I can barely handle it; I'm working overtime every day.

readings.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn de gōng zuò liàng fù hè de liǎo ma?

entries.example: 他在公司的級別比我高。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's at a higher rank than me in the company.
entries.question: 在你的公司，級別高的人薪水比較多嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: In your company, do people at higher levels earn more?
entries.answer: 對，級別越高，薪水越多。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the higher the level, the higher the pay.

entries.example: 下樓梯的時候，請扶著欄杆。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please hold the railing when you go down the stairs.
entries.question: 你會在陽台的欄杆上曬東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you hang things to dry on your balcony railing?
entries.answer: 會，我常常把棉被掛在欄杆上曬。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often hang my comforter on the railing to air it in the sun.

readings.examplePinyin: xià lóu tī de shí hòu, qǐng fú zhe lán gān.

entries.example: 她每個月都捐錢給慈善團體。
entries.exampleEnglish: She donates money to charity every month.
entries.question: 你捐過錢給慈善團體嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever donated money to a charity?
entries.answer: 捐過，我每年都捐給一個慈善團體。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I donate to a charity every year.

entries.example: 台北的房價高得驚人。
entries.exampleEnglish: Housing prices in Taipei are astonishingly high.
entries.question: 台灣有什麼讓你覺得很驚人？
entries.questionEnglish: What about Taiwan do you find amazing?
entries.answer: 台灣便利商店的數量很驚人。
entries.answerEnglish: The number of convenience stores in Taiwan is amazing.

readings.examplePinyin: tái běi de fáng jià gāo de jīng rén.

entries.example: 水從這根管子流出來。
entries.exampleEnglish: Water comes out of this pipe.
entries.question: 你家的水管出過問題嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have the pipes in your home ever had problems?
entries.answer: 有，上個月廚房的管子漏水。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a pipe in the kitchen leaked last month.

readings.examplePinyin: shuǐ cóng zhè gēn guǎn zi liú chū lái.
readings.answerPinyin: yǒu, shàng gè yuè chú fáng de guǎn zi lòu shuǐ.

entries.example: 我終於克服了怕水的問題。
entries.exampleEnglish: I finally got over my fear of water.
entries.question: 學中文的時候，你克服了什麼困難？
entries.questionEnglish: What difficulties have you overcome while learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我克服了聲調的問題，現在說得比較好了。
entries.answerEnglish: I overcame my trouble with tones, and now I speak better.

readings.answerPinyin: wǒ kè fú le shēng diào de wèn tí, xiàn zài shuō de bǐ jiào hǎo le.

entries.example: 我在公司還很資淺，要學的很多。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm still junior at the company and have a lot to learn.
entries.question: 你在公司算資深還是資淺？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you senior or junior at your company?
entries.answer: 我還很資淺，才來半年。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm still junior; I've only been there six months.

entries.example: 傷口要保持乾淨，不然會感染。
entries.exampleEnglish: Keep the wound clean, or it will get infected.
entries.question: 怎麼做可以避免感染流感？
entries.questionEnglish: What can you do to avoid catching the flu?
entries.answer: 常常洗手、打疫苗，可以避免感染。
entries.answerEnglish: Washing your hands often and getting vaccinated helps you avoid infection.

readings.questionPinyin: zěn me zuò kě yǐ bì miǎn gǎn rǎn liú gǎn?
readings.answerPinyin: cháng cháng xǐ shǒu, dǎ yì miáo, kě yǐ bì miǎn gǎn rǎn.

entries.example: 我在墾丁的海邊撿了很多貝殼。
entries.exampleEnglish: I picked up lots of seashells on the beach in Kenting.
entries.question: 你在海邊撿過貝殼嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever collected shells at the beach?
entries.answer: 撿過，我家裡有一盒貝殼。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a box of shells at home.

entries.example: 你的臉色好蒼白，還好嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: You look so pale. Are you OK?
entries.question: 你生病的時候臉色會蒼白嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you look pale when you're sick?
entries.answer: 會，我感冒的時候臉色很蒼白。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I look very pale when I have a cold.

entries.example: 那真是一個愚蠢的決定。
entries.exampleEnglish: That was a really foolish decision.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼行為很愚蠢？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of behavior do you think is foolish?
entries.answer: 我覺得騎車滑手機很愚蠢。
entries.answerEnglish: I think looking at your phone while riding is foolish.

entries.example: 以前有錢人家裡都有僕人。
entries.exampleEnglish: In the past, wealthy families all had servants.
entries.question: 如果有一個僕人，你想讓他做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: If you had a servant, what would you have them do?
entries.answer: 我想讓僕人幫我打掃房子。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd have the servant clean my house.

entries.example: 買衣服以前，我會先看標籤。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before I buy clothes, I check the label.
entries.question: 你買食物的時候會看標籤嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you read the labels when you buy food?
entries.answer: 會，我都會看營養標籤。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always read the nutrition label.

entries.example: 她是我們公司的高階主管。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a senior executive at our company.
entries.question: 你想上高階的中文課嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to take an advanced Chinese class?
entries.answer: 想，我明年想上高階的課。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I want to take an advanced class next year.

entries.example: 石頭一丟進水裡就沉下去了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The stone sank as soon as it was thrown into the water.
entries.question: 你游泳的時候會一直往下沉嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep sinking when you swim?
entries.answer: 不會，我很會游泳，不會沉下去。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm a good swimmer, so I don't sink.

entries.example: 現在的年輕人傾向晚一點結婚。
entries.exampleEnglish: Young people nowadays tend to marry later.
entries.question: 你傾向自己煮飯還是外食？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you tend to cook for yourself or eat out?
entries.answer: 我傾向外食，因為比較方便。
entries.answerEnglish: I tend to eat out, because it's more convenient.

entries.example: 冬天的到來，讓人想吃薑母鴨。
entries.exampleEnglish: The arrival of winter makes people crave ginger duck.
entries.question: 你最期待哪個節日的到來？
entries.questionEnglish: Which holiday are you most looking forward to?
entries.answer: 我最期待春節的到來。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most looking forward to Chinese New Year.

entries.example: 這裡的水果要秤重算錢。
entries.exampleEnglish: The fruit here is priced by weight.
entries.question: 你寄包裹以前會先秤重嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you weigh your packages before mailing them?
entries.answer: 會，我都先秤重再去郵局寄。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always weigh them first, then go to the post office.

entries.example: 他在偏遠的山區當醫生。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a doctor in a remote mountain area.
entries.question: 你想住在偏遠的地方嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to live somewhere remote?
entries.answer: 不想，偏遠的地方交通不方便。
entries.answerEnglish: No, getting around in remote places is inconvenient.

entries.example: 這家小店的甜點讓人很驚豔。
entries.exampleEnglish: The desserts at this little shop are stunning.
entries.question: 你吃過讓你驚豔的台灣小吃嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you had any Taiwanese street food that wowed you?
entries.answer: 吃過，割包讓我很驚豔。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, gua bao really wowed me.

entries.example: 我們討論了很久，最終決定去花蓮。
entries.exampleEnglish: We talked it over for a long time and finally decided to go to Hualien.
entries.question: 你學中文的最終目標是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's your ultimate goal in learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我的最終目標是用中文工作。
entries.answerEnglish: My ultimate goal is to work in Chinese.

entries.example: 我同事是咖啡愛好者，每天喝三杯。
entries.exampleEnglish: My coworker is a coffee lover; he drinks three cups a day.
entries.question: 你是什麼運動的愛好者？
entries.questionEnglish: What sport are you a fan of?
entries.answer: 我是棒球愛好者，常去看比賽。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm a baseball fan; I often go to games.

entries.example: 我和我太太是在捷運上相遇的。
entries.exampleEnglish: My wife and I met on the MRT.
entries.question: 你和你最好的朋友在哪裡相遇？
entries.questionEnglish: Where did you meet your best friend?
entries.answer: 我們是在語言學校相遇的。
entries.answerEnglish: We met at a language school.

entries.example: 他爺爺七十歲的時候失明了。
entries.exampleEnglish: His grandfather went blind at seventy.
entries.question: 你覺得失明的人在台北生活方便嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think life in Taipei is convenient for blind people?
entries.answer: 還算方便，捷運對失明的人很友善。
entries.answerEnglish: Fairly convenient; the MRT is friendly to blind people.

entries.example: 看到他們結婚，我心裡充滿了喜悅。
entries.exampleEnglish: Seeing them get married filled my heart with joy.
entries.question: 最近什麼事讓你感到喜悅？
entries.questionEnglish: What has brought you joy recently?
entries.answer: 通過中文考試讓我感到很喜悅。
entries.answerEnglish: Passing my Chinese exam filled me with joy.

entries.example: 沒有主管的許可，不能進這個房間。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can't enter this room without the manager's permission.
entries.question: 你在台灣工作需要工作許可嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you need a work permit to work in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 需要，我去年申請了工作許可。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I applied for a work permit last year.

entries.example: 他用一根竿子把樹上的球拿下來。
entries.exampleEnglish: He used a pole to get the ball down from the tree.
entries.question: 你家陽台有曬衣服的竿子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a pole for drying clothes on your balcony?
entries.answer: 有，我們陽台有兩根竿子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are two poles on our balcony.

readings.examplePinyin: tā yòng yì gēn gān zi bǎ shù shàng de qiú ná xià lái.
readings.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yáng tái yǒu shài yī fu de gān zi ma?
readings.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men yáng tái yǒu liǎng gēn gān zi.

entries.example: 這個設計很有想像力。
entries.exampleEnglish: This design is very imaginative.
entries.question: 你覺得自己有想像力嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're imaginative?
entries.answer: 我覺得我很有想像力，喜歡畫畫。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm quite imaginative; I like drawing.

entries.example: 我在歐洲旅行時參觀了一座宮殿。
entries.exampleEnglish: When I traveled in Europe, I visited a palace.
entries.question: 你參觀過哪個國家的宮殿？
entries.questionEnglish: Which country's palaces have you visited?
entries.answer: 我參觀過英國和法國的宮殿。
entries.answerEnglish: I've visited palaces in the UK and France.

entries.example: 我們這次去墾丁住在一間度假村。
entries.exampleEnglish: This time in Kenting we stayed at a resort.
entries.question: 你喜歡住度假村還是民宿？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer staying at resorts or B&Bs?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡住度假村，比較舒服。
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer resorts; they're more comfortable.

entries.example: 去爬玉山前，要先準備好裝備。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before climbing Jade Mountain, you need to get your gear ready.
entries.question: 你運動的時候需要什麼裝備？
entries.questionEnglish: What gear do you need when you exercise?
entries.answer: 我騎腳踏車需要安全帽和其他裝備。
entries.answerEnglish: For cycling I need a helmet and other gear.

entries.example: 白色的桌子上有很多咖啡的痕跡。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of coffee marks on the white table.
entries.question: 你的行李箱上有很多痕跡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your suitcase have a lot of marks on it?
entries.answer: 有，上面都是旅行留下的痕跡。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's covered in marks from my travels.

readings.examplePinyin: bái sè de zhuō zi shàng yǒu hěn duō kā fēi de hén jī.
readings.questionPinyin: nǐ de xíng li xiāng shàng yǒu hěn duō hén jī ma?
readings.answerPinyin: yǒu, shàng miàn dōu shì lǚ xíng liú xià de hén jī.

entries.example: 這個包包是用真的皮革做的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bag is made of real leather.
entries.question: 你有皮革做的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have anything made of leather?
entries.answer: 有，我的皮夾是皮革做的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my wallet is made of leather.

entries.example: 這個公式可以幫你算每個月的花費。
entries.exampleEnglish: This formula can help you calculate your monthly expenses.
entries.question: 你工作的時候會用到公式嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use formulas at work?
entries.answer: 會，我常在表格裡用公式算錢。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often use formulas in spreadsheets to calculate money.

entries.example: 悠遊卡的儲值上限是一萬元。
entries.exampleEnglish: The top-up limit on an EasyCard is NT$10,000.
entries.question: 你每個月買衣服的花費有上限嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a monthly limit on what you spend on clothes?
entries.answer: 有，我每個月的上限是三千塊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my monthly limit is three thousand dollars.

readings.examplePinyin: yōu yóu kǎ de chú zhí shàng xiàn shì yí wàn yuán.

entries.example: 他的中文說得很出色，像台灣人一樣。
entries.exampleEnglish: His Chinese is excellent, just like a Taiwanese person's.
entries.question: 你身邊誰的工作表現最出色？
entries.questionEnglish: Who around you does the most outstanding work?
entries.answer: 我的主管表現最出色，大家都很佩服她。
entries.answerEnglish: My supervisor is the most outstanding; everyone admires her.

entries.example: 找了一個月的工作都沒有消息，他覺得很絕望。
entries.exampleEnglish: After a month of job hunting with no news, he felt desperate.
entries.question: 你有沒有覺得很絕望的時候？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever felt hopeless?
entries.answer: 有，剛來台灣找不到房子時很絕望。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when I first came to Taiwan and couldn't find a place, I felt desperate.

entries.example: 買零食前，我會先看成分。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before buying snacks, I check the ingredients.
entries.question: 你買東西會看成分嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check the ingredients when you shop?
entries.answer: 會，我會看成分有沒有花生。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check whether the ingredients include peanuts.

entries.example: 這部台劇的情節很吸引人。
entries.exampleEnglish: The plot of this Taiwanese drama is really gripping.
entries.question: 你喜歡情節簡單還是複雜的電影？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like movies with simple or complicated plots?
entries.answer: 我喜歡情節複雜一點的電影。
entries.answerEnglish: I like movies with more complicated plots.

entries.example: 這件事跟我沒關係，我是無辜的！
entries.exampleEnglish: This has nothing to do with me; I'm innocent!
entries.question: 你小時候做錯事會裝無辜嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: As a kid, did you act innocent when you did something wrong?
entries.answer: 會，我常常裝出很無辜的樣子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often put on an innocent look.

entries.example: 我用平底鍋煎蛋。
entries.exampleEnglish: I fry eggs in a frying pan.
entries.question: 你家有平底鍋嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a frying pan at home?
entries.answer: 有，我常用平底鍋做早餐。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often use the frying pan to make breakfast.

entries.example: 我們的友誼已經十年了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our friendship has lasted ten years.
entries.question: 你覺得網路上的友誼是真的嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think online friendships are real?
entries.answer: 我覺得網路上也可以有真的友誼。
entries.answerEnglish: I think real friendships can happen online too.

entries.example: 從台北去宜蘭要經過雪山隧道。
entries.exampleEnglish: To get from Taipei to Yilan you go through the Hsuehshan Tunnel.
entries.question: 你走過最長的隧道在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where is the longest tunnel you've been through?
entries.answer: 我走過最長的隧道是雪山隧道。
entries.answerEnglish: The longest tunnel I've been through is the Hsuehshan Tunnel.

entries.example: 搬家公司開了一輛大貨車來。
entries.exampleEnglish: The moving company came with a big truck.
entries.question: 你搬家的時候有租貨車嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you rent a truck when you moved?
entries.answer: 有，我租了一輛小貨車。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I rented a small truck.

entries.example: 外面好熱，我們找個陰涼的地方休息吧。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's so hot out; let's find a shady spot to rest.
entries.question: 夏天你喜歡去哪裡找陰涼的地方？
entries.questionEnglish: In summer, where do you like to go to find some shade?
entries.answer: 我喜歡去公園大樹下陰涼的地方。
entries.answerEnglish: I like the shady spots under the big trees in the park.

entries.example: 他的道歉很真誠，我原諒他了。
entries.exampleEnglish: His apology was sincere, so I forgave him.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人對你真誠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people are sincere with you?
entries.answer: 很真誠，我的台灣朋友都很照顧我。
entries.answerEnglish: Very sincere; my Taiwanese friends take good care of me.

entries.example: 這個月工作很辛苦，我買了新鞋給自己當獎賞。
entries.exampleEnglish: Work was hard this month, so I bought myself new shoes as a reward.
entries.question: 你完成一件大事後，會給自己什麼獎賞？
entries.questionEnglish: After finishing something big, how do you reward yourself?
entries.answer: 我會吃一頓好吃的當作獎賞。
entries.answerEnglish: I treat myself to a nice meal as a reward.

readings.examplePinyin: zhè ge yuè gōng zuò hěn xīn kǔ, wǒ mǎi le xīn xié gěi zì jǐ dàng jiǎng shǎng.

entries.example: 學中文有什麼訣竅嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Is there any trick to learning Chinese?
entries.question: 你學語言有什麼訣竅？
entries.questionEnglish: What's your trick for learning languages?
entries.answer: 我的訣竅是每天跟台灣人聊天。
entries.answerEnglish: My secret is chatting with Taiwanese people every day.

entries.example: 這次旅行的亮點是看日出。
entries.exampleEnglish: The highlight of this trip was watching the sunrise.
entries.question: 你今年最大的亮點是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What has been your biggest highlight this year?
entries.answer: 今年最大的亮點是我通過了中文考試。
entries.answerEnglish: My biggest highlight this year was passing my Chinese exam.

entries.example: 昨天附近的工廠發生爆炸，大家都嚇到了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Yesterday there was an explosion at a nearby factory, and everyone was shocked.
entries.question: 你的手機訊息常常爆炸嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your phone often get flooded with messages?
entries.answer: 會，過年的時候群組訊息都會爆炸。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, at Chinese New Year my group chats explode with messages.

entries.example: 他的聲音很響亮，大家都聽得很清楚。
entries.exampleEnglish: His voice is loud and clear; everyone can hear him well.
entries.question: 你覺得自己的聲音響亮嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your voice is loud and clear?
entries.answer: 不太響亮，我說話比較小聲。
entries.answerEnglish: Not very; I speak rather softly.

entries.example: 地震以後，大家迅速離開大樓。
entries.exampleEnglish: After the earthquake, everyone quickly left the building.
entries.question: 你回覆訊息的速度迅速嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you reply to messages quickly?
entries.answer: 很迅速，我通常五分鐘內就回。
entries.answerEnglish: Very quickly; I usually reply within five minutes.

entries.example: 颱風天不出門是明智的選擇。
entries.exampleEnglish: Staying in on a typhoon day is a wise choice.
entries.question: 你做過最明智的決定是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the wisest decision you've ever made?
entries.answer: 我最明智的決定是來台灣學中文。
entries.answerEnglish: My wisest decision was coming to Taiwan to study Chinese.

entries.example: 運動可以減輕工作的壓力。
entries.exampleEnglish: Exercise can ease work stress.
entries.question: 你都怎麼減輕壓力？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you relieve stress?
entries.answer: 我會去河濱公園跑步減輕壓力。
entries.answerEnglish: I go running in the riverside park to relieve stress.

entries.example: 台北的房租對年輕人是很大的負擔。
entries.exampleEnglish: Rent in Taipei is a big burden for young people.
entries.question: 你覺得生活中最大的負擔是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the biggest burden in your life?
entries.answer: 我最大的負擔是房租。
entries.answerEnglish: My biggest burden is rent.

entries.english: hard to avoid; inevitably; bound to
entries.example: 剛搬到台灣，難免會不習慣。
entries.exampleEnglish: When you've just moved to Taiwan, you're bound to feel out of place.
entries.question: 說中文的時候，你難免會犯什麼錯？
entries.questionEnglish: When you speak Chinese, what mistakes are you bound to make?
entries.answer: 我難免會說錯聲調。
entries.answerEnglish: I inevitably get some tones wrong.

entries.example: 這個問題你可以打電話諮詢客服。
